/* Client Sound Kit - panel logic */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var MIN_DB = -40, MAX_DB = 6;
  var AUDIO_EXT = /\.(wav|mp3|aif|aiff|m4a|aac|flac|ogg|wma)$/i;

  // Premiere Pro's 16 label colours, in label index order (default colours).
  var LABELS = [
    { name: 'Violet', hex: '#a990dd' }, { name: 'Iris', hex: '#e384ae' },
    { name: 'Caribbean', hex: '#1db3a3' }, { name: 'Lavender', hex: '#d29ff0' },
    { name: 'Cerulean', hex: '#1e9be3' }, { name: 'Forest', hex: '#5d9f43' },
    { name: 'Rose', hex: '#e56ba3' }, { name: 'Mango', hex: '#f39a2f' },
    { name: 'Purple', hex: '#9c49d9' }, { name: 'Blue', hex: '#3f62e8' },
    { name: 'Teal', hex: '#2bb5b8' }, { name: 'Magenta', hex: '#e636b5' },
    { name: 'Tan', hex: '#d8b38a' }, { name: 'Green', hex: '#3fc244' },
    { name: 'Brown', hex: '#9e6533' }, { name: 'Yellow', hex: '#e4d83a' }
  ];
  var DEFAULT_SFX_COLORS = [13, 8, 9, 7, 2, 6, 15, 4];
  var TAGS = [
    { id: 'intro', name: 'Intro', color: 3 },
    { id: 'middle', name: 'Middle', color: 10 },
    { id: 'ending', name: 'Ending', color: 8 }
  ];
  var BGM_COLOR = 3;
  // Frameshift: Premiere lets you rename and recolour the 16 labels (Preferences > Labels). Use the
  // names and colours this Premiere really has, so the colour picked here is the one on the timeline.
  if (window.__cskLabels && window.__cskLabels.length) {
    window.__cskLabels.forEach(function (l, i) {
      if (!LABELS[i] || !l) return;
      if (l.name) LABELS[i].name = l.name;
      if (l.hex) LABELS[i].hex = l.hex;
    });
    var findLabel = function (re) { for (var i = 0; i < LABELS.length; i++) if (re.test(LABELS[i].name)) return i; return -1; };
    var sfxL = findLabel(/^\s*sfx\b|sound ?effects?/i), bgmL = findLabel(/^\s*bgm\b|^\s*music\b/i);
    if (sfxL >= 0) DEFAULT_SFX_COLORS = [sfxL];
    if (bgmL >= 0) { BGM_COLOR = bgmL; TAGS.forEach(function (t) { t.color = bgmL; }); }
  }
  var KIND_NAMES = { sfx: 'sound effects', part: 'BGM parts', bgm: 'full BGM tracks' };

  // ---------- Host bridge ----------
  var inCEP = typeof window.__adobe_cep__ !== 'undefined';
  function host(script) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve) {
      if (!inCEP) return resolve('ERR|Open this panel inside Premiere Pro to use this.');
      window.__adobe_cep__.evalScript(script, function (r) { resolve(String(r || '')); });
    });
  }
  function q(v) { return JSON.stringify(String(v)); }
  function hostJson(script) {
    return host(script).then(function (r) {
      if (r.indexOf('OK|') !== 0) throw new Error(r.split('|').slice(1).join('|') || 'Premiere didn’t respond.');
      return JSON.parse(r.slice(3));
    });
  }

  // ---------- Storage (Documents/ClientSoundKit/library.json) ----------
  var nodeFs = null, nodePath = null, LIB_DIR = '', LIB_FILE = '';
  try {
    nodeFs = window.require('fs'); nodePath = window.require('path');
    LIB_DIR = nodePath.join(window.require('os').homedir(), 'Documents', 'ClientSoundKit');
    LIB_FILE = nodePath.join(LIB_DIR, 'library.json');
  } catch (e) { nodeFs = null; }

  function uid() { return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7); }

  function defaultLib() {
    var id = uid();
    return { version: 3, activeClient: id, activeKind: 'sfx', ignored: {},
      clients: [{ id: id, name: 'My first client', assets: [] }] };
  }

  function migrate(l) {
    l.clients.forEach(function (c) {
      c.assets.forEach(function (a, i) {
        delete a.count; delete a.gap;
        if (a.color == null) a.color = a.kind === 'bgm' ? BGM_COLOR : DEFAULT_SFX_COLORS[i % DEFAULT_SFX_COLORS.length];
        if (a.track == null) a.track = a.kind === 'sfx' ? 1 : 3;
        if (a.kind === 'part') {
          if (!a.keys) a.keys = [];
          if (!a.tag) a.tag = 'intro';
          if (a.in == null) a.in = 0;
          if (a.out == null) a.out = 6;
          if (!a.mode) a.mode = 'media';
        }
      });
    });
    if (!l.ignored) l.ignored = {};
    l.version = 3;
    return l;
  }

  function loadLib() {
    try {
      var raw = nodeFs
        ? (nodeFs.existsSync(LIB_FILE) ? nodeFs.readFileSync(LIB_FILE, 'utf8') : null)
        : window.localStorage.getItem('csk-library');
      if (raw) {
        var l = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (l && Array.isArray(l.clients) && l.clients.length) return migrate(l);
      }
    } catch (e) { setTimeout(function () { setStatus('Couldn’t read the library file, started fresh: ' + e.message, 'err'); }); }
    return defaultLib();
  }

  var saveTimer = null;
  function save() {
    clearTimeout(saveTimer);
    saveTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      var raw = JSON.stringify(lib);
      try {
        if (nodeFs) {
          if (!nodeFs.existsSync(LIB_DIR)) nodeFs.mkdirSync(LIB_DIR, { recursive: true });
          var tmp = LIB_FILE + '.tmp';
          nodeFs.writeFileSync(tmp, raw, 'utf8');
          nodeFs.renameSync(tmp, LIB_FILE);
        } else {
          window.localStorage.setItem('csk-library', raw);
        }
      } catch (e) { setStatus('Couldn’t save: ' + e.message, 'err'); }
    }, 250);
  }

  var lib = loadLib();

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  var $ = function (s) { return document.querySelector(s); };
  function client() {
    return lib.clients.find(function (c) { return c.id === lib.activeClient; }) || lib.clients[0];
  }
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v)); }
  function baseName(p) { return String(p).split(/[\\/]/).pop().replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ''); }
  function fileExists(p) { try { return nodeFs ? nodeFs.existsSync(p) : true; } catch (e) { return true; } }
  function fmtDb(db) {
    var n = Math.round(Number(db) * 10) / 10;
    return (n > 0 ? '+' : n < 0 ? '−' : '') + Math.abs(n).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' dB';
  }
  function fmtSec(s) { return (Math.round(s * 100) / 100).toFixed(2) + ' s'; }
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }
  function fileUrl(p) {
    var s = String(p).replace(/\\/g, '/');
    return encodeURI('file://' + (s.charAt(0) === '/' ? '' : '/') + s).replace(/#/g, '%23');
  }
  function tagOf(id) { return TAGS.find(function (t) { return t.id === id; }) || TAGS[0]; }
  function partLen(a) { return Math.max(0, (a.out || 0) - (a.in || 0)); }
  function volLabel(a) {
    if (a.inFile && a.kind === 'part' && (!a.keys || !a.keys.length) && !a.db) return a.inFile;
    if (a.kind === 'part' && a.keys && a.keys.length > 1) {
      return fmtDb(a.keys[0][1]).replace(' dB', '') + ' → ' + fmtDb(a.keys[a.keys.length - 1][1]);
    }
    if (a.kind === 'part' && a.keys && a.keys.length === 1) return fmtDb(a.keys[0][1]);
    return fmtDb(a.db);
  }
  function timecode(sec, fps) {
    var f = Math.round(fps || 25), total = Math.round(sec * (fps || 25));
    var fr = total % f, s = Math.floor(total / f), p = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; };
    return p(Math.floor(s / 3600)) + ':' + p(Math.floor(s / 60) % 60) + ':' + p(s % 60) + ':' + p(fr);
  }

  var statusEl = $('#status');
  function setStatus(msg, kind) {
    statusEl.textContent = msg;
    statusEl.className = 'status' + (kind ? ' ' + kind : '');
  }

  // ---------- Audio decoding & analysis ----------
  var actx = null;
  function audioCtx() { return actx || (actx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)()); }

  function readFile(path) {
    if (nodeFs) {
      return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
        nodeFs.readFile(path, function (err, buf) {
          if (err) rej(err); else res(buf.buffer.slice(buf.byteOffset, buf.byteOffset + buf.byteLength));
        });
      });
    }
    return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open('GET', fileUrl(path)); x.responseType = 'arraybuffer';
      x.onload = function () { x.response ? res(x.response) : rej(new Error('empty')); };
      x.onerror = function () { rej(new Error('read failed')); };
      x.send();
    });
  }

  // Keeps a few decoded files in memory so hovering, dragging and checking stay fast.
  var bufCache = [], BUF_LIMIT = 6;
  function decode(path) {
    for (var i = 0; i < bufCache.length; i++) {
      if (bufCache[i].path === path) { var hit = bufCache.splice(i, 1)[0]; bufCache.unshift(hit); return hit.p; }
    }
    var p = readFile(path).then(function (ab) {
      return new Promise(function (res, rej) { audioCtx().decodeAudioData(ab, res, rej); });
    });
    bufCache.unshift({ path: path, p: p });
    if (bufCache.length > BUF_LIMIT) bufCache.length = BUF_LIMIT;
    p.catch(function () { bufCache = bufCache.filter(function (b) { return b.p !== p; }); });
    return p;
  }

  // Waveform peaks + envelope for [from, to] seconds of the buffer.
  function analyzeBuffer(buf, from, to) {
    var sr = buf.sampleRate, ch = buf.numberOfChannels, data = [], c;
    for (c = 0; c < ch; c++) data.push(buf.getChannelData(c));
    var s0 = clamp(Math.floor((from || 0) * sr), 0, buf.length);
    var s1 = clamp(to ? Math.floor(to * sr) : buf.length, s0 + 1, buf.length);
    var n = s1 - s0;
    var BINS = n / sr > 30 ? 640 : 320, peaks = new Array(BINS), per = Math.max(1, Math.floor(n / BINS));
    for (var b = 0; b < BINS; b++) {
      var m = 0, a0 = s0 + b * per, a1 = Math.min(s1, a0 + per);
      for (var i = a0; i < a1; i += 2) {
        var v = 0; for (c = 0; c < ch; c++) v += Math.abs(data[c][i]);
        v /= ch; if (v > m) m = v;
      }
      peaks[b] = m;
    }
    var pmax = Math.max.apply(null, peaks) || 1;
    peaks = peaks.map(function (p) { return Math.round((p / pmax) * 1000) / 1000; });
    var hop = 256, win = 1024, env = [];
    for (var s = s0; s + hop <= s1; s += hop) {
      var sum = 0, e = Math.min(s1, s + win), cnt = 0;
      for (var k = s; k < e; k += 2) {
        var x = 0; for (c = 0; c < ch; c++) x += data[c][k];
        x /= ch; sum += x * x; cnt++;
      }
      env.push(Math.sqrt(sum / Math.max(1, cnt)));
    }
    return { dur: n / sr, fileDur: buf.duration, peaks: peaks, env: env, hop: hop / sr };
  }

  // sens: 0 (fewer beats) .. 1 (more beats)
  function detectOnsets(an, sens) {
    var env = an.env, hop = an.hop, max = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < env.length; i++) if (env[i] > max) max = env[i];
    if (!max) return [0];
    var thr = max * (0.62 - 0.5 * sens);
    var onsets = [], armed = true, peak = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < env.length; i++) {
      var v = env[i];
      if (armed && v >= thr) {
        var j = i;
        while (j > 0 && env[j - 1] < env[j] && env[j - 1] > thr * 0.12) j--;
        var t = j * hop;
        if (!onsets.length || t - onsets[onsets.length - 1] >= 0.05) onsets.push(Math.round(t * 1000) / 1000);
        armed = false; peak = v;
      } else if (!armed) {
        if (v > peak) peak = v;
        if (v < Math.max(thr * 0.55, peak * 0.35)) armed = true;
      }
    }
    if (!onsets.length) onsets.push(0);
    if (onsets[0] <= 0.03) onsets[0] = 0;
    return onsets;
  }

  function analysisKey(a) {
    var k = String(a.path);
    try { if (nodeFs) { var st = nodeFs.statSync(a.path); k += '|' + st.size + '|' + Math.round(st.mtimeMs); } } catch (e) {}
    if (a.kind === 'part') k += '|' + a.in + '|' + a.out;
    return k;
  }

  var envCache = {}; // asset id -> analysis (envelope kept in memory only)
  var analyzing = {};
  function ensureAnalysis(a, force) {
    if (!fileExists(a.path)) return Promise.resolve();
    var key = analysisKey(a);
    var have = a.wave && a.wave.key === key && !a.wave.error && (a.kind !== 'sfx' || a.wave.onsets);
    if (have && !force) return Promise.resolve();
    if (analyzing[a.id]) return analyzing[a.id];
    var p = decode(a.path).then(function (buf) {
      if (a.kind === 'part') {
        a.in = clamp(a.in, 0, buf.duration);
        a.out = clamp(a.out, a.in + 0.05, buf.duration);
        key = analysisKey(a);
      }
      var an = a.kind === 'part' ? analyzeBuffer(buf, a.in, a.out) : analyzeBuffer(buf);
      envCache[a.id] = an;
      var sens = a.wave && a.wave.sens != null ? a.wave.sens : 0.5;
      a.wave = { key: key, dur: an.dur, fileDur: an.fileDur, peaks: an.peaks, sens: sens };
      if (a.kind === 'sfx') a.wave.onsets = detectOnsets(an, sens);
    }).catch(function () {
      a.wave = { key: key, error: true };
    }).then(function () {
      delete analyzing[a.id];
      // If the edit copy was made before the waveform finished, hand it over.
      if (editing && editing.id === a.id && editing.draft !== a && (!editing.draft.wave || editing.draft.wave.key !== a.wave.key)) {
        editing.draft.wave = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(a.wave));
        if (a.kind === 'part' && editing.draft.path === a.path) { editing.draft.in = a.in; editing.draft.out = a.out; }
      }
      if (!(editing && editing.draft === a)) save();
      refreshCard(a.id);
    });
    analyzing[a.id] = p;
    return p;
  }

  // Seconds at which to stop so only `beats` beats play. 0 = whole sound.
  function outForBeats(a, beats) {
    var on = a.wave && a.wave.onsets;
    if (!on || !beats || beats >= on.length) return 0;
    return Math.max(0.02, on[beats] - 0.004);
  }

  // ---------- State ----------
  var editing = null;   // { id, draft }
  var hover = {};       // id -> beats under the pointer / keyboard
  var seqTracks = 8;
  var bgmSel = {};       // full BGM id -> { a, b } selected seconds
  var view = 'sounds';  // 'sounds' or 'settings'

  function assetById(id) { return client().assets.find(function (a) { return a.id === id; }); }
  function viewAsset(id) { return editing && editing.id === id ? editing.draft : assetById(id); }

  // ---------- Rendering: header ----------
  function renderClients() {
    var sel = $('#clientSelect');
    sel.innerHTML = lib.clients.map(function (c) {
      return '<option value="' + c.id + '">' + esc(c.name) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
    sel.value = client().id;
  }

  function renderTabs() {
    var inSettings = view === 'settings';
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function (t) {
      var on = !inSettings && t.dataset.kind === lib.activeKind;
      t.classList.toggle('active', on);
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', on);
    });
    $('#settingsBtn').classList.toggle('on', inSettings);
    var isCheck = !inSettings && lib.activeKind === 'check';
    $('#list').classList.toggle('hidden', inSettings || isCheck);
    $('#check').classList.toggle('hidden', !isCheck);
    $('#settings').classList.toggle('hidden', !inSettings);
    $('#dropzone').classList.toggle('hidden', inSettings || isCheck);
    $('#captureBtn').classList.toggle('hidden', lib.activeKind !== 'part');
    $('#addSelected').classList.toggle('hidden', lib.activeKind === 'part');
    $('#dropHint').textContent = lib.activeKind === 'part'
      ? 'Select a keyframed BGM clip on the timeline, then press Save selected timeline clip'
      : 'or drag audio files here';
  }

  function trackLabel(t) { return t < 0 ? 'Auto' : 'A' + (t + 1); }
  function trackOptions(sel) {
    var html = '<option value="-1"' + (sel === -1 ? ' selected' : '') + '>Auto (first free)</option>';
    for (var i = 0; i < 12; i++) html += '<option value="' + i + '"' + (sel === i ? ' selected' : '') + '>A' + (i + 1) + '</option>';
    return html;
  }
  function faderPct(db) { return ((clamp(db, MIN_DB, MAX_DB) - MIN_DB) / (MAX_DB - MIN_DB)) * 100; }

  function faderHtml(db) {
    var pct = faderPct(db), zero = faderPct(0);
    return '<div class="fader">' +
      '<div class="fader-track" tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-label="Volume" aria-valuemin="' + MIN_DB +
        '" aria-valuemax="' + MAX_DB + '" aria-valuenow="' + db + '">' +
        '<div class="fader-fill" style="width:' + pct + '%"></div>' +
        '<div class="fader-zero" style="left:' + zero + '%"></div>' +
        '<div class="fader-line" style="left:' + pct + '%"></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<input class="db" data-f="db" type="number" step="0.5" min="' + MIN_DB + '" max="' + MAX_DB + '" value="' + db + '" aria-label="Volume in dB">' +
    '</div>';
  }

  // ---------- Rendering: edit drawer ----------
  function partVolumeHtml(d) {
    return '<div class="erow"><label>Volume keyframes <span class="cname" data-role="kcount">' + (d.keys.length ? '(' + d.keys.length + ')' : '') + '</span></label>' +
      '<div class="seg">' +
        '<button data-act="preset" data-p="flat">Flat</button>' +
        '<button data-act="preset" data-p="down">High \u2192 low</button>' +
        '<button data-act="preset" data-p="up">Low \u2192 high</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="note">Add as many as you like: click the line on the waveform above, drag a point to move it, double-click a point to delete it.</div>' +
      '<div data-role="krows">' + keyRowsHtml(d) + '</div>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function editHtml(d) {
    var swatches = LABELS.map(function (l, i) {
      return '<button class="swatch' + (d.color === i ? ' on' : '') + '" data-act="color" data-i="' + i +
        '" style="--c:' + l.hex + '" title="' + l.name + '" aria-label="' + l.name + '"></button>';
    }).join('');
    var parts = '';
    if (d.kind === 'part') {
      parts =
        '<div class="erow"><label>Section</label><div class="seg">' +
          TAGS.map(function (t) {
            return '<button data-act="tag" data-t="' + t.id + '" class="' + (d.tag === t.id ? 'on' : '') + '">' + t.name + '</button>';
          }).join('') + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class="erow"><label>Part of the file <span class="cname">' + fmtSec(partLen(d)) +
          (d.wave && d.wave.fileDur ? ' of ' + fmtSec(d.wave.fileDur) : '') + '</span></label>' +
          '<div class="inout"><span>From</span><input type="number" step="0.1" min="0" data-f="in" value="' + d.in + '">' +
          '<span>to</span><input type="number" step="0.1" min="0" data-f="out" value="' + d.out + '"><span>s</span></div></div>' +
        partVolumeHtml(d);
    }
    var vol = d.kind !== 'part' ? '<div class="erow"><label>Volume</label>' + faderHtml(d.db) + '</div>' : '';
    if (d.kind === 'bgm') vol += '<div class="erow"><label>Fade in and out</label><div class="inout">' +
      '<span>In</span><input type="number" step="0.5" min="0" data-f="fadeIn" value="' + (d.fadeIn == null ? 1 : d.fadeIn) + '">' +
      '<span>s</span><span>Out</span><input type="number" step="0.5" min="0" data-f="fadeOut" value="' + (d.fadeOut == null ? 2 : d.fadeOut) + '"><span>s</span></div>' +
      '<div class="note">Added as volume keyframes when you place or drag it. 0 = no fade.</div></div>';
    var beats = d.kind === 'sfx'
      ? '<div class="erow"><label>Beat detection</label>' +
          '<div class="sens"><span>Fewer</span><input type="range" data-f="sens" min="0" max="1" step="0.05" value="' +
          (d.wave && d.wave.sens != null ? d.wave.sens : 0.5) + '" aria-label="Beat detection sensitivity"><span>More</span></div>' +
          '<div class="note" data-role="beatcount"></div></div>'
      : '';
    return '' +
      '<div class="edit">' +
        '<div class="erow"><label>Name</label><input data-f="name" value="' + esc(d.name) + '"></div>' +
        '<div class="erow realfile"><label>File</label><span class="cname" title="' + esc(d.path) + '">' + esc(baseFile(d.path)) + '</span>' +
          '<button class="mini" data-act="reveal">Show in ' + (IS_WIN ? 'Explorer' : 'Finder') + '</button></div>' +
        parts + vol +
        '<div class="erow"><label>Track</label><select data-f="track">' + trackOptions(d.track) + '</select></div>' +
        '<div class="erow"><label>Clip colour <span class="cname" data-role="cname">' + LABELS[d.color].name + '</span></label><div class="swatches">' + swatches + '</div></div>' +
        beats +
        '<div class="erow"><label>File</label><div class="filerow"><span class="file" title="' + esc(d.path) + '"><bdi>' + esc(d.path) + '</bdi></span>' +
          '<button class="mini" data-act="preview">Listen</button><button class="mini" data-act="relink">Relink</button></div></div>' +
        '<div class="eactions">' +
          '<button class="danger" data-act="remove">Remove</button>' +
          '<span class="spacer"></span>' +
          '<button data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>' +
          '<button class="save" data-act="save">Save</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  // ---------- Rendering: cards ----------
  function cardHtml(a) {
    var isEdit = editing && editing.id === a.id;
    var v = isEdit ? editing.draft : a;
    var missing = !fileExists(v.path);
    var col = LABELS[v.color] ? LABELS[v.color].hex : '#888';
    var dragWave = !isEdit && v.kind !== 'bgm';
    var body;
    if (missing) {
      body = '<div class="missing-row">File not found. <button class="mini" data-act="relink">Relink</button></div>';
    } else {
      body = '<div class="wave"' + (dragWave ? ' draggable="true"' : '') + ' tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Waveform of ' + esc(v.name) + '. ' +
          (v.kind === 'sfx' ? 'Arrow keys pick beats, ' : '') + 'Enter places at the playhead.">' +
          '<canvas></canvas></div>' +
        '<div class="hint-row"><span class="hint-text" data-role="hint"></span>' +
          (v.kind === 'bgm' ? '' : '<button class="place" data-act="place">' + (v.kind === 'sfx' ? 'Place all' : 'Place') + '</button>') +
        '</div>' +
        (v.kind === 'bgm' && !isEdit
          ? '<div class="bgm-actions">' +
              '<button class="mini" data-act="listen">Listen</button>' +
              '<button class="mini" data-act="clearsel" disabled>Clear</button>' +
              '<button class="mini" data-act="aspart" disabled title="Keep this section in BGM parts">Save as part</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="bgm-go">' +
              '<span class="drag-handle" draggable="true" data-act="drag" title="Drag onto the timeline" role="button" tabindex="0">⠇ Drag to timeline</span>' +
              '<button class="place" data-act="place">Place</button>' +
            '</div>'
          : '');
    }
    return '' +
      '<div class="card ' + v.kind + (missing ? ' missing' : '') + (isEdit ? ' editing' : '') + '" data-id="' + a.id + '" style="--c:' + col + '">' +
        '<div class="card-top">' +
          '<span class="dot" data-role="dot" title="' + LABELS[v.color].name + '"></span>' +
          '<span class="name" data-role="name" title="' + esc(v.name + (baseFile(a.path) !== v.name ? '  (file: ' + baseFile(a.path) + ')' : '')) + '">' + esc(v.name) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="badge" data-role="vol" title="Saved volume">' + volLabel(v) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="badge" data-role="track" title="Track">' + trackLabel(v.track) + '</span>' +
          (isEdit ? '' : '<button class="icon edit-btn" data-act="edit" title="Edit this sound" aria-label="Edit ' + esc(v.name) + '">✎</button>') +
        '</div>' +
        body +
        (isEdit ? editHtml(v) : '') +
      '</div>';
  }

  function renderList() {
    var list = $('#list');
    var kind = lib.activeKind;
    if (kind === 'check') return;
    var assets = client().assets.filter(function (a) { return a.kind === kind; });
    if (!assets.length) {
      var how = kind === 'part'
        ? 'Keyframe a BGM section on the timeline the way you like it, select the clip, then press Save selected timeline clip.'
        : 'Add sounds below. Set each one’s level, track and colour once and reuse them on every video.';
      list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No ' + KIND_NAMES[kind] + ' for ' + esc(client().name) + ' yet.<br>' + how + '</div>';
      return;
    }
    if (kind === 'part') {
      list.innerHTML = TAGS.map(function (t) {
        var group = assets.filter(function (a) { return (editing && editing.id === a.id ? editing.draft.tag : a.tag) === t.id; });
        if (!group.length) return '';
        return '<div class="group">' + t.name + '<span>' + group.length + '</span></div>' + group.map(cardHtml).join('');
      }).join('');
    } else {
      list.innerHTML = assets.map(cardHtml).join('');
    }
    assets.forEach(function (a) { refreshCard(a.id); ensureAnalysis(a); });
  }

  function renderAll() {
    renderClients(); renderTabs();
    if (view === 'settings') renderSettings();
    else if (lib.activeKind === 'check') renderCheck();
    else renderList();
  }

  function fmtClock(s) {
    s = Math.max(0, s || 0);
    var m = Math.floor(s / 60), r = s - m * 60;
    return m + ':' + (r < 10 ? '0' : '') + r.toFixed(1);
  }
  function yOfDb(db, H) { return 4 + ((MAX_DB - clamp(db, MIN_DB, MAX_DB)) / (MAX_DB - MIN_DB)) * (H - 8); }
  function dbOfY(y, H) { return MAX_DB - clamp((y - 4) / (H - 8), 0, 1) * (MAX_DB - MIN_DB); }
  function flash(id) {
    var c = document.querySelector('.card[data-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (!c) return;
    c.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
    c.classList.add('flash');
    setTimeout(function () { c.classList.remove('flash'); }, 1400);
  }

  // Draws the waveform + updates hint text for one card.
  function refreshCard(id) {
    var card = document.querySelector('.card[data-id="' + id + '"]');
    var a = viewAsset(id);
    if (!card || !a) return;
    var isEdit = editing && editing.id === id;
    var canvas = card.querySelector('canvas');
    var hint = card.querySelector('[data-role="hint"]');
    var w = a.wave;
    var onsets = a.kind === 'sfx' && w && w.onsets;
    var total = onsets ? onsets.length : 0;
    var sel = hover[id] || 0;
    var range = a.kind === 'bgm' ? bgmSel[id] : null;
    var isPlaying = playing && playing.id === id;

    if (hint) {
      if (!w || analyzing[a.id]) hint.textContent = 'Reading waveform…';
      else if (w.error) hint.textContent = 'Can’t draw this file’s waveform. Place still works.';
      else if (a.kind === 'part' && isEdit) {
        var k = kf && kf.id === id && kf.idx != null ? a.keys[kf.idx] : null;
        hint.innerHTML = k
          ? 'Keyframe <b>' + (kf.idx + 1) + ' of ' + a.keys.length + '</b>: ' + fmtSec(k[0]) + ', ' + fmtDb(k[1])
          : (a.keys.length ? a.keys.length + ' keyframes · ' : '') + 'click to add · drag to move · double-click to delete';
      }
      else if (a.kind === 'bgm') {
        hint.innerHTML = range
          ? 'Selected <b>' + fmtClock(range.a) + '–' + fmtClock(range.b) + '</b> (' + fmtSec(range.b - range.a) + ')'
          : fmtClock(w.dur) + ' · drag across the wave to pick a part';
      }
      else if (a.kind === 'part') hint.textContent = fmtSec(partLen(a)) + (a.keys.length ? ' · ' + a.keys.length + ' keyframes' : '') + ' · click to place, or drag to the timeline';
      else if (isEdit) hint.textContent = total + ' beat' + (total === 1 ? '' : 's');
      else if (sel && sel < total) hint.innerHTML = 'Click or drag <b>' + sel + ' of ' + total + ' beats</b> (' + fmtSec(outForBeats(a, sel)) + ')';
      else if (sel) hint.innerHTML = 'Click or drag <b>all ' + total + ' beat' + (total > 1 ? 's' : '') + '</b> (' + fmtSec(w.dur) + ')';
      else hint.textContent = total + ' beat' + (total === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' · hover to pick how many, then click or drag';
    }
    var bc = card.querySelector('[data-role="beatcount"]');
    if (bc) bc.textContent = total ? 'Found ' + total + ' beat' + (total === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' in this sound.' : '';
    var kc = card.querySelector('[data-role="kcount"]');
    if (kc) kc.textContent = a.keys && a.keys.length ? '(' + a.keys.length + ')' : '';
    var lb = card.querySelector('[data-act="listen"]');
    if (lb) lb.textContent = isPlaying ? 'Stop' : (range ? 'Listen to part' : 'Listen');
    var clr = card.querySelector('[data-act="clearsel"]'); if (clr) clr.disabled = !range;
    var ap = card.querySelector('[data-act="aspart"]'); if (ap) ap.disabled = !range;
    var pl = card.querySelector('.bgm-go [data-act="place"]'); if (pl) pl.textContent = range ? 'Place part' : 'Place';

    if (!canvas) return;
    var box = canvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var W = Math.max(10, Math.floor(box.width)), H = Math.max(10, Math.floor(box.height));
    canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px'; canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    var g = canvas.getContext('2d');
    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    g.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    if (!w || w.error || !w.peaks) return;

    var col = LABELS[a.color].hex;
    var dur = w.dur || 1;
    // Highlighted span, as fractions of the width.
    var h0 = 0, h1 = 0;
    if (a.kind === 'sfx' && sel && !isEdit) { h1 = sel >= total ? 1 : outForBeats(a, sel) / dur; }
    else if (range) { h0 = range.a / dur; h1 = range.b / dur; }
    else if (a.kind === 'part' && sel && !isEdit) h1 = 1;
    var hasHi = h1 > h0;

    var mid = H / 2 + (a.kind === 'sfx' ? 5 : 0), amp = (H - (a.kind === 'sfx' ? 14 : 6)) / 2;
    var n = w.peaks.length, bw = W / n, i;
    if (hasHi) { g.fillStyle = col; g.globalAlpha = 0.16; g.fillRect(h0 * W, 0, (h1 - h0) * W, H); g.globalAlpha = 1; }
    var dim = a.kind === 'part';
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var x = i * bw, f = x / W, hh = Math.max(1, w.peaks[i] * amp);
      var inHi = hasHi && f >= h0 && f < h1;
      g.fillStyle = inHi || !hasHi ? col : '#5b5b5b';
      g.globalAlpha = dim ? (inHi ? 0.75 : 0.45) : (inHi ? 1 : (hasHi ? 0.85 : 0.75));
      g.fillRect(x, mid - hh, Math.max(1, bw - 0.6), hh * 2);
    }
    g.globalAlpha = 1;
    if (range) {
      g.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      g.fillRect(Math.round(h0 * W), 0, 2, H);
      g.fillRect(Math.round(h1 * W) - 2, 0, 2, H);
    }

    if (onsets) {
      g.font = '600 10px -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
      g.textBaseline = 'top';
      onsets.forEach(function (t, k2) {
        var x2 = Math.round((t / dur) * W) + 0.5;
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.55)'; g.fillRect(x2, 0, 1, H);
        var label = String(k2 + 1), active = sel && k2 < sel && !isEdit;
        g.fillStyle = active ? col : '#2a2a2a';
        g.fillRect(x2, 0, g.measureText(label).width + 6, 12);
        g.fillStyle = active ? '#141414' : '#cfcfcf';
        g.fillText(label, x2 + 3, 1);
      });
    }

    // BGM part: the saved volume keyframes drawn like Premiere's rubber band.
    if (a.kind === 'part') {
      var len = partLen(a) || 1;
      var keys = a.keys.slice().sort(function (p, q2) { return p[0] - q2[0]; });
      var pts = keys.length
        ? keys.map(function (k3) { return [clamp(k3[0] / len, 0, 1) * W, yOfDb(k3[1], H)]; })
        : [[0, yOfDb(a.db, H)], [W, yOfDb(a.db, H)]];
      if (isEdit) {
        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.12)'; g.lineWidth = 1;
        [0, -12, -24, -36].forEach(function (db) {
          var yy = Math.round(yOfDb(db, H)) + 0.5;
          g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, yy); g.lineTo(W, yy); g.stroke();
          g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.4)'; g.font = '10px -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
          g.textBaseline = 'bottom'; g.fillText(db === 0 ? '0 dB' : String(db), 3, yy - 1);
        });
      }
      g.strokeStyle = '#f2f2f2'; g.lineWidth = 1.5; g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(0, pts[0][1]);
      pts.forEach(function (p) { g.lineTo(p[0], p[1]); });
      g.lineTo(W, pts[pts.length - 1][1]);
      g.stroke();
      if (keys.length) {
        var r0 = isEdit ? 4.5 : 3.2;
        a.keys.forEach(function (k4, idx) {
          var px = clamp(clamp(k4[0] / len, 0, 1) * W, r0 + 1, W - r0 - 1), py = yOfDb(k4[1], H);
          var hot = isEdit && kf && kf.id === id && (kf.idx === idx || kf.hover === idx);
          g.fillStyle = hot ? col : '#f2f2f2';
          g.beginPath(); g.arc(px, py, hot ? r0 + 1.5 : r0, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();
          g.strokeStyle = '#1b1b1b'; g.lineWidth = 1; g.stroke();
        });
      }
    }

    if (isPlaying) {
      var pt = (playing.audio.currentTime - playing.offset) / dur;
      if (pt >= 0 && pt <= 1) { g.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; g.fillRect(Math.round(pt * W), 0, 2, H); }
    }
  }

  // ---------- Placing ----------
  var placing = false;
  function place(a, beats, btn) {
    if (placing) return;
    if (!fileExists(a.path)) { setStatus('File missing. Edit the sound and use Relink.', 'err'); return; }
    var script, what = a.name, range = a.kind === 'bgm' ? bgmSel[a.id] : null;
    if (a.kind === 'part') {
      var keys = a.keys.map(function (k) { return Number(k[0]) + ':' + Number(k[1]); }).join(';');
      script = 'FrameshiftSK.placePart(' + q(a.path) + ',' + q(client().name) + ',' + Number(a.track) + ',' +
        Number(a.in) + ',' + Number(a.out) + ',' + q(keys) + ',' + q(a.mode || 'media') + ',' + clipDb(a) + ',' + Number(a.color) + ')';
    } else if (range) {
      what = a.name + ' (' + fmtClock(range.a) + '–' + fmtClock(range.b) + ')';
      script = 'FrameshiftSK.placePart(' + q(a.path) + ',' + q(client().name) + ',' + Number(a.track) + ',' +
        range.a + ',' + range.b + ',' + q(bgmFadeKeys(a, range.b - range.a)) + ',"media",' + clipDb(a) + ',' + Number(a.color) + ')';
    } else if (a.kind === 'bgm' && a.wave && a.wave.fileDur && bgmFadeKeys(a, a.wave.fileDur)) {
      script = 'FrameshiftSK.placePart(' + q(a.path) + ',' + q(client().name) + ',' + Number(a.track) + ',0,0,' +
        q(bgmFadeKeys(a, a.wave.fileDur)) + ',"media",' + clipDb(a) + ',' + Number(a.color) + ')';
    } else {
      var out = a.kind === 'sfx' ? outForBeats(a, beats) : 0;
      var total = a.wave && a.wave.onsets ? a.wave.onsets.length : 0;
      if (a.kind === 'sfx' && out) what = a.name + ' (' + beats + ' of ' + total + ' beats)';
      script = 'FrameshiftSK.place(' + q(a.path) + ',' + q(client().name) + ',' + clipDb(a) + ',' +
        Number(a.track) + ',' + out + ',' + Number(a.color) + ')';
    }
    placing = true; if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    setStatus('Placing ' + what + '…');
    host(script).then(function (r) {
      var p = r.split('|');
      if (p[0] === 'OK') {
        var volOk = p[2] === '1';
        setStatus('Placed ' + what + ' on ' + p[1] + ' at ' + volLabel(a) + colourNote(r) +
          (volOk ? '' : '. Volume wasn’t applied, check Effect Controls.'), volOk ? 'ok' : 'err');
      } else setStatus(p.slice(1).join('|') || 'Premiere didn’t respond.', 'err');
    }).then(function () { placing = false; if (btn) btn.disabled = false; });
  }

  // ---------- Edit mode ----------
  function startEdit(id) {
    if (editing && editing.id !== id) cancelEdit(true);
    var a = assetById(id);
    editing = { id: id, draft: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(a)) };
    renderList();
    var card = document.querySelector('.card.editing');
    if (card) { card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); var ni = card.querySelector('[data-f="name"]'); if (ni) ni.focus(); }
  }
  function cancelEdit(silent) {
    editing = null; stopPreview();
    if (!silent) { renderList(); setStatus('No changes saved.'); }
  }
  function saveEdit() {
    var a = assetById(editing.id), d = editing.draft;
    if (d.kind === 'part') {
      if (!(d.out > d.in)) { setStatus('The part’s end must be after its start.', 'err'); return; }
      var dupE = duplicateOf('part', d.path, d.in, d.out, d.id);
      if (dupE) { setStatus(dupMessage(dupE) + ' Change From/To so this part covers different seconds.', 'err'); return; }
      d.keys = d.keys.map(function (k) { return [clamp(Number(k[0]) || 0, 0, partLen(d)), clamp(Number(k[1]) || 0, MIN_DB, MAX_DB)]; })
        .sort(function (p, q2) { return p[0] - q2[0]; });
    }
    var reanalyze = a.path !== d.path || (d.kind === 'part' && (a.in !== d.in || a.out !== d.out));
    Object.keys(d).forEach(function (k) { a[k] = d[k]; });
    a.name = (a.name || '').trim() || baseName(a.path);
    if (a.kind === 'part' && (a.keys.length || a.db)) delete a.inFile;
    editing = null; stopPreview(); save(); renderList();
    (reanalyze ? ensureAnalysis(a, true) : Promise.resolve()).then(function () { afterAssetChange(a); });
    setStatus('Saved ' + a.name + ': ' + volLabel(a) + ', ' + trackLabel(a.track) + ', ' + LABELS[a.color].name + '.', 'ok');
  }

  function updateDraftBadges(card) {
    var d = editing.draft;
    card.querySelector('[data-role="vol"]').textContent = volLabel(d);
    card.querySelector('[data-role="track"]').textContent = trackLabel(d.track);
    card.querySelector('[data-role="name"]').textContent = d.name;
  }

  function setDraftDb(card, db) {
    var d = editing.draft;
    d.db = Math.round(clamp(db, MIN_DB, MAX_DB) * 2) / 2;
    var pct = faderPct(d.db);
    card.querySelector('.fader-fill').style.width = pct + '%';
    card.querySelector('.fader-line').style.left = pct + '%';
    card.querySelector('.fader-track').setAttribute('aria-valuenow', d.db);
    var input = card.querySelector('.db');
    if (document.activeElement !== input) input.value = d.db;
    updateDraftBadges(card);
    refreshCard(d.id);
  }

  function redetect() {
    var d = editing.draft;
    var run = function () {
      var an = envCache[d.id];
      if (!an || !d.wave) return;
      d.wave.onsets = detectOnsets(an, d.wave.sens);
      refreshCard(d.id);
    };
    if (envCache[d.id]) run();
    else decode(d.path).then(function (buf) { envCache[d.id] = analyzeBuffer(buf); run(); }).catch(function () {});
  }

  // ---------- Preview ----------
  var playing = null; // { id, audio, offset, to, btn, d }
  function stopPreview() {
    if (!playing) return;
    var p = playing; playing = null;
    p.audio.pause();
    if (p.btn && p.btn.dataset.act === 'preview') p.btn.textContent = 'Listen';
    refreshCard(p.id);
  }
  // Plays d from `from` to `to` seconds of the file (to 0 = end), following its saved level.
  function preview(d, from, to, btn) {
    if (playing && playing.id === d.id && playing.btn === btn) { stopPreview(); return; }
    stopPreview();
    var au = new Audio(fileUrl(d.path));
    var offset = d.kind === 'part' ? d.in : 0;
    var p = { id: d.id, audio: au, offset: offset, to: to, btn: btn, d: d };
    playing = p;
    function level() {
      var t = au.currentTime - offset;
      var db = d.kind === 'part' && d.keys.length ? gainAt(d, t) : d.db;
      return clamp(Math.pow(10, (db - (d.bakedDb || 0)) / 20), 0, 1);
    }
    function tick() {
      if (playing !== p) return;
      if (p.to && au.currentTime >= p.to) { stopPreview(); return; }
      au.volume = level();
      refreshCard(d.id);
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    au.onended = function () { if (playing === p) stopPreview(); };
    au.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function () {
      au.currentTime = from || 0;
      au.volume = level();
      au.play().then(function () {
        if (btn && btn.dataset.act === 'preview') btn.textContent = 'Stop';
        refreshCard(d.id); tick();
      }).catch(function () {
        if (playing === p) stopPreview();
        setStatus('Can’t play this file here. It can still be placed.', 'err');
      });
    });
    au.onerror = function () { if (playing === p) { stopPreview(); setStatus('Can’t play this file here. It can still be placed.', 'err'); } };
    refreshCard(d.id);
  }

  // ---------- Files ----------
  function pickFiles(multi) {
    if (window.cep && window.cep.fs && window.cep.fs.showOpenDialogEx) {
      var r = window.cep.fs.showOpenDialogEx(multi, false, 'Choose sound files', '',
        ['wav', 'mp3', 'aif', 'aiff', 'm4a', 'aac', 'flac', 'ogg']);
      return Promise.resolve(r && r.err === 0 ? (r.data || []) : []);
    }
    return host('FrameshiftSK.pickFiles()').then(function (r) {
      return r.indexOf('OK|') === 0 ? r.slice(3).split('\n').filter(Boolean) : [];
    });
  }

  function newAsset(kind, path, extra) {
    var existing = client().assets.filter(function (a) { return a.kind === 'sfx'; }).length;
    var a = { id: uid(), name: baseName(path), path: path, kind: kind };
    if (kind === 'sfx') { a.db = -10; a.track = 1; a.color = DEFAULT_SFX_COLORS[existing % DEFAULT_SFX_COLORS.length]; }
    else if (kind === 'bgm') { a.db = -22; a.track = 3; a.color = BGM_COLOR; }
    else { a.db = -18; a.track = 3; a.tag = 'intro'; a.color = tagOf('intro').color; a.in = 0; a.out = 6; a.keys = []; a.mode = 'media'; a.name = baseName(path) + ' part'; }
    if (extra) Object.keys(extra).forEach(function (k) { a[k] = extra[k]; });
    return a;
  }

  function addFiles(paths) {
    paths = paths.filter(function (p) { return p && AUDIO_EXT.test(p); });
    if (!paths.length) { setStatus('No audio files found. Supported: wav, mp3, aif, m4a, aac, flac, ogg.', 'err'); return; }
    var kind = lib.activeKind, added = [], skipped = [];
    paths.forEach(function (p) {
      var dup = kind !== 'part' ? duplicateOf(kind, p) : null;
      if (!dup) dup = added.filter(function (x) { return sameAudio(x.path, p); })[0] && { kind: kind, name: baseName(p) };
      if (dup) { skipped.push(dup); return; }
      var a = newAsset(kind, p); client().assets.push(a); added.push(a);
    });
    if (!added.length) { setStatus(skipped.length === 1 ? dupMessage(skipped[0]) : 'All ' + skipped.length + ' were already in ' + KIND_NAME[kind] + '.', 'err'); return; }
    save();
    added.forEach(function (a) { ensureAnalysis(a).then(function () { afterAssetChange(a); }); });
    if (kind === 'part' && added.length === 1) {
      startEdit(added[0].id);
      setStatus('Set which seconds of the file to use and its volume shape, then Save.', 'ok');
    } else {
      renderList();
      setStatus('Added ' + added.length + ' sound' + (added.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + (skipped.length ? ' (' + skipped.length + ' already there, skipped)' : '') + '. Press ✎ on a sound to set its level, track and colour.', 'ok');
    }
  }

  // Intro if it starts near the beginning of the sequence, Ending if it finishes near the end.
  function guessTag(c) {
    var end = Number(c.seqEnd) || 0, st = Number(c.start) || 0, fin = st + (c.outS - c.inS);
    if (end > 0) {
      if (st < Math.max(8, end * 0.15)) return 'intro';
      if (fin > end * 0.85) return 'ending';
      return 'middle';
    }
    return 'intro';
  }

  // Frameshift: every selected clip is saved. Clips of one song that follow each other on the
  // timeline and in the song (a song cut in two) become one part; other clips become their own parts.
  function joinCaptured(clips) {
    var out = [];
    clips.forEach(function (c) {
      var prev = out[out.length - 1];
      if (prev && prev.path === c.path && Math.abs(c.start - prev.end) < 0.05 && Math.abs(c.inS - prev.outS) < 0.05) {
        // keys are relative to each clip's start; the second clip starts this far into the joined part
        var offset = c.inS - prev.inS;
        prev.keys = prev.keys.concat((c.keys || []).map(function (k) { return [Math.round((k[0] + offset) * 1000) / 1000, k[1]]; }))
          .filter(function (k, i, arr) { return !i || Math.abs(k[0] - arr[i - 1][0]) > 0.0005; });
        prev.outS = c.outS; prev.end = c.end; prev.joined = (prev.joined || 1) + 1;
      } else out.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(c)));
    });
    return out;
  }
  // Frameshift: selected clips that are pieces of one song lying one after another on the timeline
  // (an edited ending, a song with a section cut out) are one BGM part. Other clips are their own parts.
  function groupCaptured(list) {
    var groups = [];
    list.slice().sort(function (x, y) { return x.start - y.start; }).forEach(function (c) {
      var g = null;
      for (var i = groups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var last = groups[i][groups[i].length - 1];
        if (last.path === c.path && c.start - last.end < 1.0 && c.start >= last.start) { g = groups[i]; break; }
      }
      if (g) g.push(c); else groups.push([c]);
    });
    return groups;
  }
  function cleanKeys(keys) {
    keys.sort(function (x, y) { return x[0] - y[0]; });
    var out = [];
    keys.forEach(function (k) {
      var t = Math.round(k[0] * 1000) / 1000, prev = out[out.length - 1];
      if (prev && Math.abs(t - prev[0]) < 0.01) {
        if (Math.abs(k[1] - prev[1]) < 0.05) return;  // the same point twice
        t = prev[0] + 0.01;                            // a jump in level: keep both, just apart
      }
      out.push([t, Math.round(k[1] * 100) / 100]);
    });
    return out;
  }
  // Keys of every clip of a group on one time line starting at the group's first clip. A clip
  // without keyframes keeps its fixed level as two keys.
  function groupKeys(g) {
    var keys = [];
    g.forEach(function (c) {
      var off = c.start - g[0].start, len = c.end - c.start;
      var ks = c.keys && c.keys.length ? c.keys : [[0, c.db], [len, c.db]];
      ks.forEach(function (k) { if (k[0] >= -0.001 && k[0] <= len + 0.001) keys.push([off + Math.max(0, Math.min(len, k[0])), k[1]]); });
    });
    return cleanKeys(keys);
  }
  // A transition's fade (Constant Power shape) written as keyframes over [0, fadeIn] and
  // [len - fadeOut, len]; keyframes inside a fade are replaced by it.
  function withFades(keys, len, fi, fo, db) {
    fi = Math.min(Number(fi) || 0, len / 2); fo = Math.min(Number(fo) || 0, len / 2);
    if (!(fi > 0.02) && !(fo > 0.02)) return keys;
    if (!keys.length) keys = [[0, db], [len, db]];
    function at(t) {
      if (t <= keys[0][0]) return keys[0][1];
      for (var i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) if (t <= keys[i][0]) {
        var sp = keys[i][0] - keys[i - 1][0] || 1; return keys[i - 1][1] + (keys[i][1] - keys[i - 1][1]) * (t - keys[i - 1][0]) / sp;
      }
      return keys[keys.length - 1][1];
    }
    var shape = [[0, null], [0.25, -8.34], [0.5, -3.01], [0.75, -0.69]];
    var out = [], lvIn = at(fi), lvOut = at(len - fo);
    if (fi > 0.02) { shape.forEach(function (s) { out.push([s[0] * fi, s[1] === null ? MIN_DB : Math.max(MIN_DB, lvIn + s[1])]); }); out.push([fi, lvIn]); }
    keys.forEach(function (k) { if ((!(fi > 0.02) || k[0] > fi + 0.005) && (!(fo > 0.02) || k[0] < len - fo - 0.005)) out.push(k); });
    if (fo > 0.02) { out.push([len - fo, lvOut]); shape.slice().reverse().forEach(function (s) { out.push([len - s[0] * fo, s[1] === null ? MIN_DB : Math.max(MIN_DB, lvOut + s[1])]); }); }
    return cleanKeys(out);
  }
  // The pieces as one WAV: each piece where it sits on the timeline, at full level (the volume is
  // in the keyframes). Same pieces, same file name, so saving them again is caught as a duplicate.
  function renderGroup(g) {
    return decode(g[0].path).then(function (buf) {
      var sr = buf.sampleRate, nCh = buf.numberOfChannels, total = 0, c, i;
      g.forEach(function (x) { total = Math.max(total, x.end - g[0].start); });
      var n = Math.max(1, Math.round(total * sr)), chs = [], peak = 0;
      for (c = 0; c < nCh; c++) chs.push(new Float32Array(n));
      g.forEach(function (x) {
        var d0 = Math.round((x.start - g[0].start) * sr), s0 = Math.round(x.inS * sr), len = Math.round((x.end - x.start) * sr);
        for (c = 0; c < nCh; c++) {
          var src = buf.getChannelData(c), dst = chs[c];
          for (i = 0; i < len && d0 + i < n && s0 + i < src.length; i++) { var v = src[s0 + i]; dst[d0 + i] = v; if (v > peak) peak = v; else if (-v > peak) peak = -v; }
        }
      });
      var sig = g.map(function (x) { return x.inS.toFixed(2) + '-' + x.outS.toFixed(2) + '@' + (x.start - g[0].start).toFixed(2); }).join(',');
      var dir = nodePath.join(LIB_DIR, 'Parts', safeName(client().name));
      mkdirp(dir);
      var file = nodePath.join(dir, safeName(baseName(g[0].path)) + ' [' + g.length + ' pieces ' + hashStr(g[0].path + sig) + '].wav');
      nodeFs.writeFileSync(file, new Uint8Array(encodeWav(chs, sr, peak > 0.999)));
      return { file: file, len: n / sr };
    });
  }
  function captureFromTimeline() {
    setStatus('Reading the selected clips…');
    hostJson('FrameshiftSK.captureSelected()').then(function (list) {
      if (!(list instanceof Array)) list = [list];
      var groups = groupCaptured(list), saved = [], dups = [], joined = 0;
      var jobs = groups.map(function (g) {
        var first = g[0], last = g[g.length - 1], tag = guessTag({ seqEnd: first.seqEnd, start: first.start, inS: 0, outS: last.end - first.start });
        var name = baseName(first.path) + ' ' + g.map(function (x) { return fmtClock(x.inS) + '–' + fmtClock(x.outS); }).join(' + ');
        var common = { name: name, mode: 'media', track: first.track >= 0 ? first.track : 3, tag: tag, color: tagOf(tag).color };
        if (g.length === 1) {
          var dup1 = duplicateOf('part', first.path, first.inS, first.outS);
          if (dup1) { dups.push(dup1); return Promise.resolve(); }
          var k1 = withFades(cleanKeys((first.keys || []).slice()), first.outS - first.inS, first.fadeIn, first.fadeOut, first.db);
          saved.push(newAsset('part', first.path, Object.assign(common, { in: first.inS, out: first.outS, keys: k1, db: k1.length ? k1[0][1] : first.db })));
          return Promise.resolve();
        }
        joined++;
        var keys = withFades(groupKeys(g), last.end - first.start, first.fadeIn, last.fadeOut, first.db);
        return renderGroup(g).then(function (r) {
          var dupG = duplicateOf('part', r.file, 0, r.len);
          if (dupG) { dups.push(dupG); return; }
          saved.push(newAsset('part', r.file, Object.assign(common, { in: 0, out: r.len, keys: keys, db: keys.length ? keys[0][1] : first.db, source: first.path })));
        });
      });
      return Promise.all(jobs).then(function () {
        if (!saved.length) { setStatus(dups.length ? dupMessage(dups[0]) : 'Nothing to save.', 'err'); return; }
        saved.forEach(function (a) { client().assets.push(a); });
        save();
        editing = null; view = 'sounds'; lib.activeKind = 'part';
        renderAll(); saved.forEach(function (a) { flash(a.id); ensureAnalysis(a).then(function () { afterAssetChange(a); }); });
        var joinedNote = joined ? ' (pieces of one song next to each other were saved as one part)' : '';
        setStatus(saved.length === 1
          ? 'Saved ' + fmtSec(saved[0].out - saved[0].in) + ' to ' + tagOf(saved[0].tag).name + (saved[0].keys.length ? ' with ' + saved[0].keys.length + ' keyframes' : '') + joinedNote + '. Press ✎ any time to change it.'
          : 'Saved ' + saved.length + ' BGM parts from ' + list.length + ' selected clips' + joinedNote + (dups.length ? '; ' + dups.length + ' already saved, skipped' : '') + '.', 'ok');
      });
    }).catch(function (e) { setStatus(e.message, 'err'); });
  }

  // Frameshift: sounds dragged in from Premiere (timeline or Project panel) carry no files, but
  // they are selected in Premiere at that moment: add those. Also behind "Add selected from Premiere".
  function addFromPremiereSelection(quietIfNone) {
    if (lib.activeKind === 'part') return captureFromTimeline();
    return hostJson('FrameshiftSK.selectedMedia()').then(function (paths) {
      paths = (paths || []).filter(function (p) { return AUDIO_EXT.test(p); });
      if (paths.length) addFiles(paths);
      else if (!quietIfNone) setStatus('Select audio clips on the timeline or in the Project panel first.', 'err');
      return paths.length;
    }).catch(function (e) { setStatus(e.message, 'err'); return 0; });
  }

  // ---------- Events: cards ----------
  var list = $('#list');

  function beatsAtX(a, wave, clientX) {
    if (a.kind !== 'sfx') return 1;
    if (!a.wave || !a.wave.dur || !a.wave.onsets) return 0;
    var r = wave.getBoundingClientRect();
    var t = clamp((clientX - r.left) / r.width, 0, 1) * a.wave.dur;
    var n = 0;
    a.wave.onsets.forEach(function (o) { if (o <= t + 0.001) n++; });
    return Math.max(1, n);
  }
  function timeAtX(a, wave, clientX) {
    var r = wave.getBoundingClientRect();
    return clamp((clientX - r.left) / r.width, 0, 1) * ((a.wave && a.wave.dur) || 0);
  }
  function r2(n) { return Math.round(n * 100) / 100; }

  // ----- Keyframe editor (BGM parts, edit mode) -----
  var kf = null; // { id, idx (being dragged), hover }
  function kfHit(d, wave, e) {
    var r = wave.getBoundingClientRect(), len = partLen(d) || 1, best = -1, bestD = 10;
    d.keys.forEach(function (k, i) {
      var x = clamp(k[0] / len, 0, 1) * r.width, y = yOfDb(k[1], r.height);
      var dist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - r.left - x, e.clientY - r.top - y);
      if (dist < bestD) { bestD = dist; best = i; }
    });
    return best;
  }
  function kfPoint(d, wave, e) {
    var r = wave.getBoundingClientRect();
    return [r2(clamp((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width, 0, 1) * partLen(d)),
            Math.round(dbOfY(e.clientY - r.top, r.height) * 2) / 2];
  }
  function sortKeys(d, k) { d.keys.sort(function (p, q2) { return p[0] - q2[0]; }); return d.keys.indexOf(k); }
  function keyRowsHtml(d) {
    var len = partLen(d);
    if (!d.keys.length) return faderHtml(d.db) + '<button class="mini addk" data-act="kadd">+ Add keyframe</button>';
    return '<div class="khead"><span>Time from start</span><span>Level</span></div>' +
      '<div class="krows-scroll">' + d.keys.map(function (k, i) {
        return '<div class="krow" data-i="' + i + '">' +
          '<input type="number" step="0.1" min="0" max="' + len.toFixed(2) + '" data-f="kt" value="' + k[0] + '" aria-label="Keyframe ' + (i + 1) + ' time">' +
          '<span class="unit">s</span>' +
          '<input type="number" step="0.5" min="' + MIN_DB + '" max="' + MAX_DB + '" data-f="kd" value="' + k[1] + '" aria-label="Keyframe ' + (i + 1) + ' level">' +
          '<span class="unit">dB</span>' +
          '<button class="mini x" data-act="kdel" aria-label="Delete keyframe ' + (i + 1) + '">×</button>' +
        '</div>';
      }).join('') + '</div>' +
      '<button class="mini addk" data-act="kadd">+ Add keyframe</button>';
  }
  function refreshKeyRows(card) {
    var box = card.querySelector('[data-role="krows"]');
    if (box) box.innerHTML = keyRowsHtml(editing.draft);
    updateDraftBadges(card);
    refreshCard(editing.id);
  }

  // ----- Drag to the timeline -----
  // A WAV with the volume (and BGM-part keyframes) already in it is written to
  // Documents/ClientSoundKit/Rendered/<client>, then handed to Premiere on drag.
  var prepared = {}, preparing = {}, internalDrag = null, prepTimer = null;
  function renderDir() { return nodePath.join(LIB_DIR, 'Rendered', safeName(client().name)); }
  function hashStr(s) { var h = 0; for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) | 0; return (h >>> 0).toString(36).slice(0, 4); }
  function clockTag(s) { var m = Math.floor(s / 60); return m + 'm' + (s - m * 60).toFixed(1) + 's'; }
  function dragSpec(a) {
    var from = 0, to = 0, label = '';
    if (a.kind === 'sfx') {
      var total = a.wave && a.wave.onsets ? a.wave.onsets.length : 0, beats = hover[a.id] || total;
      to = outForBeats(a, beats) || 0;
      if (beats && beats < total) label = beats + (beats === 1 ? ' beat' : ' beats');
    } else if (a.kind === 'part') { from = a.in; to = a.out; }
    else if (bgmSel[a.id]) { from = bgmSel[a.id].a; to = bgmSel[a.id].b; label = clockTag(from) + '-' + clockTag(to); }
    // Frameshift: a BGM part with keyframes is dragged as clean audio (0 dB); after the drop the
    // keyframes are put on the clip itself (afterDrop), so they show and can be moved in Premiere.
    var len = to > from ? to - from : (a.wave && a.wave.fileDur ? a.wave.fileDur - from : 0);
    var fadeKeys = a.kind === 'bgm' ? bgmFadeKeys(a, len) : '';
    var flat = (a.kind === 'part' && a.keys.length > 0) || !!fadeKeys;
    var vol = flat ? 'flat' : String(a.db);
    var key = [a.path, a.kind, from.toFixed(3), to.toFixed(3), vol, a.bakedDb || 0].join('|');
    if (a.kind === 'part') label = (label ? label + ' ' : '') + hashStr(key);
    var file = nodePath.join(renderDir(), safeName(a.name) + ' [' + (flat ? 'keys' : volTag(a)) + ']' + (label ? ' ' + label : '') + '.wav');
    var keysStr = a.kind === 'part' && flat ? a.keys.map(function (k) { return Number(k[0]) + ':' + Number(k[1]); }).join(';') : fadeKeys;
    return { key: key + '|' + keysStr, from: from, to: to, label: a.kind === 'part' ? '' : label, file: file, flat: flat, keys: keysStr };
  }
  function prepareDrag(a) {
    if (!nodeFs || !a.wave || a.wave.error || !fileExists(a.path)) return Promise.resolve(null);
    var sp = dragSpec(a);
    if (prepared[sp.key] && nodeFs.existsSync(prepared[sp.key])) return Promise.resolve(prepared[sp.key]);
    if (preparing[sp.key]) return preparing[sp.key];
    var p = decode(a.path).then(function (buf) {
      var r = renderRange(sp.flat ? Object.assign({}, a, { keys: [], db: 0, bakedDb: 0 }) : a, buf, sp.from, sp.to);
      mkdirp(renderDir());
      nodeFs.writeFileSync(sp.file, new Uint8Array(encodeWav(r.chs, r.sr, r.useFloat)));
      prepared[sp.key] = sp.file;
      return sp.file;
    }).catch(function (e) {
      setStatus('Couldn’t get ' + a.name + ' ready for dragging: ' + e.message, 'err');
      return null;
    }).then(function (f) { delete preparing[sp.key]; return f; });
    preparing[sp.key] = p;
    return p;
  }
  function schedulePrepare(a) { clearTimeout(prepTimer); prepTimer = setTimeout(function () { prepareDrag(a); noteDropFor(a); }, 80); }

  list.addEventListener('dragstart', function (e) {
    var src = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[draggable="true"]');
    var card = src && src.closest('.card'); if (!card) return;
    var a = assetById(card.dataset.id);
    if (!a || (editing && editing.id === a.id)) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
    if (!nodeFs) { e.preventDefault(); setStatus('Dragging to the timeline works inside Premiere Pro. Click to place instead.', 'err'); return; }
    var sp = dragSpec(a), file = prepared[sp.key];
    if (!file) {
      e.preventDefault(); prepareDrag(a);
      setStatus('Getting ' + a.name + ' ready. Drag again in a moment.');
      return;
    }
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'copy';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('com.adobe.cep.dnd.file.0', file);
    internalDrag = { file: file, a: a, label: sp.label, flat: sp.flat, keys: sp.keys };

    setStatus(sp.flat ? 'Drop it on the timeline. Its volume keyframes are added to the clip once it lands.' : 'Drop it on the timeline. The volume is already in the file.');
  });
  list.addEventListener('dragend', function () {
    var d = internalDrag; internalDrag = null;
    if (!d) return;
    noted = { file: '', at: 0 };
    // Frameshift: Premiere may still be importing and placing the clip when the drag ends, so
    // look for it every half second for up to 10 seconds, then colour it (and add keyframes).
    var keys = d.flat ? d.keys : '';
    var tries = 0;
    (function look() {
      tries++;
      host('FrameshiftSK.afterDrop(' + q(d.file) + ',' + Number(d.a.color) + ',' + q(keys) + ',' + q(d.a.mode || 'media') + ',' + q(client().name) + ')').then(function (r) {
        if (r.indexOf('OK|') === 0 && Number(r.split('|')[1]) > 0) {
          setStatus('Dropped ' + d.a.name + (d.label ? ' (' + d.label + ')' : '') + ', coloured ' + LABELS[d.a.color].name +
            (keys ? ', with its ' + keys.split(';').length + ' volume keyframes' : ' at ' + volLabel(d.a)) + colourNote(r) + '.', 'ok');
        } else if (tries < 20) setTimeout(look, 500);
        else if (r.indexOf('ERR|') === 0) setStatus('Dropped, but couldn\u2019t colour it: ' + r.slice(4), 'err');
      });
    })();
  });

  // ----- BGM section selection -----
  var selDrag = null; // { id, t0, x0, moved }

  // Frameshift: presses and drags are handled from pointer events AND mouse events. Inside
  // Premiere's panels pointer events don't always arrive (selecting a BGM range did nothing), so
  // whichever comes first starts the action and the other is ignored. Moves and the release are
  // followed on the whole window, so leaving the waveform mid-drag doesn't lose them.
  var pressAt = 0, faderMove = null;
  // No pointer capture: in Premiere the release can go missing, and a captured pointer then sends
  // every later click to the waveform (the tabs and buttons stopped responding). Moves and the
  // release are followed on the whole window instead.
  function capture() {}
  function onPress(e) {
    if ((e.button || 0) !== 0) return;
    if (Date.now() - pressAt < 400) return; // the same press, seen as both pointerdown and mousedown
    var handled = press(e);
    if (handled) pressAt = Date.now();
  }
  list.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPress);
  list.addEventListener('mousedown', onPress);
  // Before a drag can start, tell Premiere which project items already use the file that would be
  // dragged, so afterDrop can tell the dropped clip apart and give it the sound's colour. Done while
  // hovering, never on the press itself: talking to Premiere as a drag begins left the panel deaf to
  // clicks afterwards.
  var noted = { file: '', at: 0 };
  function noteDropFor(a) {
    if (!a || !nodeFs || internalDrag) return;
    var f = dragSpec(a).file;
    if (f === noted.file && Date.now() - noted.at < 3000) return;
    noted = { file: f, at: Date.now() };
    host('FrameshiftSK.beforeDrop(' + q(f) + ')');
  }
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { if (faderMove) faderMove(e); else if (selDrag || (kf && kf.idx != null)) moveTo(e, true); });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', function (e) { faderMove = null; release(e); });
  window.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { faderMove = null; });
  function press(e) {
    // Volume fader (edit mode)
    var fTrack = e.target.closest('.fader-track');
    if (fTrack && editing) {
      var fcard = fTrack.closest('.card');
      capture(fTrack, e);
      var fmove = function (ev) {
        var r = fTrack.getBoundingClientRect();
        var db = MIN_DB + clamp((ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width, 0, 1) * (MAX_DB - MIN_DB);
        if (Math.abs(db) < 0.75) db = 0;
        setDraftDb(fcard, db);
      };
      fmove(e);
      faderMove = fmove;
      fTrack.onpointermove = function (ev) { if (faderMove) faderMove(ev); };
      return true;
    }
    var wave = e.target.closest('.wave'); if (!wave) return false;
    var card = wave.closest('.card'), id = card.dataset.id, a = viewAsset(id);
    if (!a || !a.wave || a.wave.error) return false;

    if (editing && editing.id === id && a.kind === 'part') {
      var hit = kfHit(a, wave, e);
      if (hit < 0) {
        if (!a.keys.length) { var len = r2(partLen(a)); a.keys = [[0, a.db], [len, a.db]]; }
        var nk = kfPoint(a, wave, e);
        a.keys.push(nk);
        hit = sortKeys(a, nk);
      }
      kf = { id: id, idx: hit, hover: hit, wave: wave };
      capture(wave, e);
      updateDraftBadges(card); refreshCard(id);
      e.preventDefault();
      return true;
    }
    if (a.kind === 'bgm' && !(editing && editing.id === id)) {
      selDrag = { id: id, t0: timeAtX(a, wave, e.clientX), x0: e.clientX, moved: false, prev: bgmSel[id], wave: wave };
      capture(wave, e);
      e.preventDefault();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  list.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { moveTo(e, false); });
  // Where on which waveform a move is: the waveform under the pointer, or (while dragging) the one
  // the drag started on, even when the pointer has left it.
  function moveTo(e, fromWindow) {
    var wave = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.wave') : null;
    var dragId = selDrag ? selDrag.id : (kf && kf.idx != null ? kf.id : null);
    if (dragId) {
      var held = document.querySelector('.card[data-id="' + dragId + '"] .wave');
      if (held) wave = held;
    } else if (fromWindow) return;
    if (!wave) return;
    var card = wave.closest('.card'), id = card.dataset.id, a = viewAsset(id);
    if (!a) return;
    // Keyframe drag / hover
    if (editing && editing.id === id && a.kind === 'part') {
      if (kf && kf.id === id && kf.idx != null) {
        var k = a.keys[kf.idx], pt = kfPoint(a, wave, e);
        var lo = kf.idx > 0 ? a.keys[kf.idx - 1][0] + 0.01 : 0;
        var hi = kf.idx < a.keys.length - 1 ? a.keys[kf.idx + 1][0] - 0.01 : partLen(a);
        k[0] = r2(clamp(pt[0], lo, hi)); k[1] = pt[1];
        updateDraftBadges(card); refreshCard(id);
      } else {
        var h = kfHit(a, wave, e);
        wave.style.cursor = h >= 0 ? 'grab' : 'crosshair';
        if (!kf || kf.id !== id || kf.hover !== h) { kf = { id: id, idx: null, hover: h }; refreshCard(id); }
      }
      return;
    }
    // BGM selection
    if (selDrag && selDrag.id === id) {
      if (Math.abs(e.clientX - selDrag.x0) > 4) selDrag.moved = true;
      if (selDrag.moved) {
        var t = timeAtX(a, wave, e.clientX);
        bgmSel[id] = { a: Math.min(selDrag.t0, t), b: Math.max(selDrag.t0, t) };
        refreshCard(id);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (editing && editing.id === id) return;
    if (a.kind === 'sfx') {
      var n = beatsAtX(a, wave, e.clientX);
      if (hover[id] !== n) { hover[id] = n; refreshCard(id); schedulePrepare(a); }
    } else if (a.kind === 'part') {
      if (!hover[id]) { hover[id] = 1; refreshCard(id); }
      schedulePrepare(a);
    }
  }

  list.addEventListener('pointerup', release);
  function release(e) {
    if (kf && kf.idx != null) {
      var card = document.querySelector('.card[data-id="' + kf.id + '"]');
      kf = { id: kf.id, idx: null, hover: kf.idx };
      if (card && editing) refreshKeyRows(card);
      return;
    }
    if (selDrag) {
      var s = selDrag; selDrag = null;
      var a = assetById(s.id), wave = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.wave') : null;
      if (!a) return;
      if (!s.moved) {
        // A click: listen from here (inside the selection: to its end).
        var t = wave ? timeAtX(a, wave, e.clientX) : s.t0, r = bgmSel[s.id];
        preview(a, t, r && t >= r.a && t < r.b ? r.b : 0, null);
      } else {
        var sel = bgmSel[s.id];
        if (sel && sel.b - sel.a < 0.2) delete bgmSel[s.id];
        refreshCard(s.id);
        if (bgmSel[s.id]) schedulePrepare(a);
      }
    }
  }

  list.addEventListener('pointerout', function (e) {
    var wave = e.target.closest('.wave'); if (!wave) return;
    if (wave.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
    var id = wave.closest('.card').dataset.id;
    if (kf && kf.id === id && kf.idx == null && kf.hover !== -1) { kf.hover = -1; refreshCard(id); }
    if (document.activeElement !== wave && !internalDrag && hover[id]) { delete hover[id]; refreshCard(id); }
  });

  list.addEventListener('pointerover', function (e) {
    var h = e.target.closest('[data-act="drag"]'); if (!h) return;
    var a = assetById(h.closest('.card').dataset.id);
    if (a) { prepareDrag(a); noteDropFor(a); }
  });

  list.addEventListener('dblclick', function (e) {
    var fTrack = e.target.closest('.fader-track');
    if (fTrack && editing) { setDraftDb(fTrack.closest('.card'), 0); return; }
    var wave = e.target.closest('.wave'); if (!wave || !editing) return;
    var card = wave.closest('.card'), d = editing.draft;
    if (card.dataset.id !== editing.id || d.kind !== 'part') return;
    var hit = kfHit(d, wave, e);
    if (hit < 0) return;
    d.keys.splice(hit, 1);
    if (d.keys.length === 1) { d.db = d.keys[0][1]; d.keys = []; }
    kf = { id: d.id, idx: null, hover: -1 };
    refreshKeyRows(card);
  });

  function presetKeys(d, p) {
    var len = r2(partLen(d));
    if (p === 'flat') { if (d.keys.length) d.db = d.keys[0][1]; d.keys = []; return; }
    var hi = -10, lo = -20;
    d.keys = p === 'down' ? [[0, hi], [len, lo]] : [[0, lo], [len, hi]];
  }

  function saveSelectionAsPart(a) {
    var r = bgmSel[a.id]; if (!r) return;
    var dupS = duplicateOf('part', a.path, r.a, r.b);
    if (dupS) { setStatus(dupMessage(dupS), 'err'); return; }
    var p = newAsset('part', a.path, {
      name: a.name + ' ' + fmtClock(r.a) + '–' + fmtClock(r.b),
      in: r2(r.a), out: r2(r.b), keys: [], db: a.db, track: a.track, tag: 'middle', color: tagOf('middle').color
    });
    client().assets.push(p); save();
    ensureAnalysis(p).then(function () { afterAssetChange(p); });
    setStatus('Saved ' + fmtSec(r.b - r.a) + ' of ' + a.name + ' to BGM parts (Middle). Change it there any time.', 'ok');
  }

  list.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var card = e.target.closest('.card'); if (!card) return;
    var id = card.dataset.id, a = assetById(id); if (!a) return;
    var wave = e.target.closest('.wave');
    if (wave) {
      if ((editing && editing.id === id) || a.kind === 'bgm') return; // handled by pointer events
      place(a, beatsAtX(a, wave, e.clientX));
      return;
    }
    var btn = e.target.closest('button, [data-act="drag"]'); if (!btn) return;
    var act = btn.dataset.act, d = editing && editing.id === id ? editing.draft : null;
    if (act === 'place') place(a, 0, btn);
    else if (act === 'drag') setStatus('Press and drag this onto the timeline.');
    else if (act === 'listen') {
      if (playing && playing.id === id) { stopPreview(); return; }
      var r = bgmSel[id];
      preview(a, r ? r.a : 0, r ? r.b : 0, null);
    }
    else if (act === 'clearsel') { delete bgmSel[id]; if (playing && playing.id === id) stopPreview(); refreshCard(id); }
    else if (act === 'aspart') saveSelectionAsPart(a);
    else if (act === 'edit') startEdit(id);
    else if (act === 'cancel') cancelEdit();
    else if (act === 'save') saveEdit();
    else if (act === 'color' && d) {
      d.color = Number(btn.dataset.i);
      card.style.setProperty('--c', LABELS[d.color].hex);
      card.querySelectorAll('.swatch').forEach(function (s) { s.classList.toggle('on', s === btn); });
      card.querySelector('[data-role="cname"]').textContent = LABELS[d.color].name;
      card.querySelector('[data-role="dot"]').title = LABELS[d.color].name;
      refreshCard(id);
    }
    else if (act === 'tag' && d) {
      var old = tagOf(d.tag);
      d.tag = btn.dataset.t;
      if (d.color === old.color) d.color = tagOf(d.tag).color; // follow the section colour unless customised
      renderList();
    }
    else if (act === 'preset' && d) { presetKeys(d, btn.dataset.p); refreshKeyRows(card); }
    else if (act === 'kadd' && d) {
      var len = partLen(d);
      if (!d.keys.length) d.keys = [[0, d.db]];
      var last = d.keys[d.keys.length - 1];
      if (last[0] >= len - 0.05) {
        // Already at the end: split the biggest gap instead.
        var gi = 0, gap = -1;
        for (var i = 1; i < d.keys.length; i++) if (d.keys[i][0] - d.keys[i - 1][0] > gap) { gap = d.keys[i][0] - d.keys[i - 1][0]; gi = i; }
        if (gap > 0.05) { var mid = [r2((d.keys[gi][0] + d.keys[gi - 1][0]) / 2), Math.round(gainAt(d, (d.keys[gi][0] + d.keys[gi - 1][0]) / 2) * 2) / 2]; d.keys.push(mid); sortKeys(d, mid); }
      } else {
        d.keys.push([r2(Math.min(len, last[0] + Math.max(0.5, len / 4))), last[1]]);
      }
      refreshKeyRows(card);
    }
    else if (act === 'kdel' && d) {
      d.keys.splice(Number(btn.closest('.krow').dataset.i), 1);
      if (d.keys.length === 1) { d.db = d.keys[0][1]; d.keys = []; }
      refreshKeyRows(card);
    }
    else if (act === 'preview') { var pd = d || a; preview(pd, pd.kind === 'part' ? pd.in : 0, pd.kind === 'part' ? pd.out : 0, btn); }
    else if (act === 'reveal') { if (d && d.path) revealFile(d.path); }
    else if (act === 'relink') {
      pickFiles(false).then(function (paths) {
        if (!paths[0]) return;
        if (d) {
          d.path = paths[0]; d.wave = null; d.bakedDb = 0; renderList();
          ensureAnalysis(d, true).then(function () { if (editing) renderList(); });
        } else {
          a.path = paths[0]; a.wave = null; a.bakedDb = 0; save(); renderList();
          ensureAnalysis(a, true).then(function () { afterAssetChange(a); });
        }
        setStatus('Relinked to ' + baseName(paths[0]) + (d ? '. Press Save to keep it.' : '.'), 'ok');
      });
    }
    else if (act === 'remove') {
      if (!window.confirm('Remove “' + a.name + '” from ' + client().name + '? The audio file stays on disk.')) return;
      client().assets = client().assets.filter(function (x) { return x.id !== id; });
      removeBaked(a, client());
      editing = null; save(); renderList();
      setStatus('Removed ' + a.name + '.' + (libraryOn() ? ' Its WAV was removed from the library folder.' : ''));
    }
  });

  list.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    if (!editing) return;
    var el = e.target, f = el.dataset.f; if (!f) return;
    var card = el.closest('.card'); var d = editing.draft;
    if (f === 'name') d.name = el.value;
    else if (f === 'db') { var v = parseFloat(el.value); if (!isNaN(v)) setDraftDb(card, v); return; }
    else if (f === 'track') d.track = parseInt(el.value, 10);
    else if (f === 'fadeIn' || f === 'fadeOut') { var fv = parseFloat(el.value); d[f] = isNaN(fv) ? 0 : Math.max(0, fv); }
    else if (f === 'sens') { if (d.wave) { d.wave.sens = parseFloat(el.value); redetect(); } }
    else if (f === 'kt' || f === 'kd') {
      var i = Number(el.closest('.krow').dataset.i), n = parseFloat(el.value);
      if (!isNaN(n)) { d.keys[i][f === 'kt' ? 0 : 1] = n; refreshCard(d.id); }
    }
    updateDraftBadges(card);
  });
  list.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
    if (!editing) return;
    var el = e.target, f = el.dataset.f, d = editing.draft;
    if (f === 'db') el.value = d.db;
    if (f === 'kt') { var k = d.keys[Number(el.closest('.krow').dataset.i)]; sortKeys(d, k); refreshKeyRows(el.closest('.card')); }
    if (f === 'in' || f === 'out') {
      var n = Math.max(0, parseFloat(el.value) || 0);
      var oldLen = partLen(d);
      d[f] = Math.round(n * 1000) / 1000;
      if (d.wave && d.wave.fileDur) d[f] = Math.min(d[f], d.wave.fileDur);
      var newLen = partLen(d);
      if (oldLen > 0 && newLen > 0 && d.keys.length) {
        d.keys = d.keys.map(function (k2) { return [r2(k2[0] / oldLen * newLen), k2[1]]; });
      }
      ensureAnalysis(d, true).then(function () { if (editing && editing.draft === d) renderList(); });
    }
  });

  list.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    var card = e.target.closest('.card'); if (!card) return;
    var id = card.dataset.id;
    var fTrack = e.target.closest('.fader-track');
    if (fTrack && editing) {
      var step = e.shiftKey ? 3 : 0.5;
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') { setDraftDb(card, editing.draft.db + step); e.preventDefault(); }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') { setDraftDb(card, editing.draft.db - step); e.preventDefault(); }
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && editing) { cancelEdit(); return; }
    var wave = e.target.closest('.wave');
    if (wave && !(editing && editing.id === id)) {
      var a = viewAsset(id), total = a.kind === 'sfx' && a.wave && a.wave.onsets ? a.wave.onsets.length : 1;
      var cur = hover[id] || total;
      if (a.kind === 'sfx' && (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowDown')) { hover[id] = Math.max(1, cur - 1); refreshCard(id); e.preventDefault(); }
      if (a.kind === 'sfx' && (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowUp')) { hover[id] = Math.min(total, cur + 1); refreshCard(id); e.preventDefault(); }
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { place(assetById(id), hover[id] || 0); e.preventDefault(); }
    }
  });
  list.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
    var wave = e.target.closest('.wave'); if (!wave) return;
    var id = wave.closest('.card').dataset.id, a = viewAsset(id);
    if (a.kind === 'sfx' && !hover[id]) { hover[id] = a.wave && a.wave.onsets ? a.wave.onsets.length : 1; refreshCard(id); }
  });
  list.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
    var wave = e.target.closest('.wave'); if (!wave) return;
    var id = wave.closest('.card').dataset.id; if (hover[id]) { delete hover[id]; refreshCard(id); }
  });

  if (window.ResizeObserver) {
    new ResizeObserver(function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(function (c) { refreshCard(c.dataset.id); });
      if (check.result && check.result.mix) drawMixGraph();
    }).observe(document.body);
  }

  // =====================================================================
  // Check: loudness, frequency bands and the whole mix
  // =====================================================================
  var BANDS = [
    { id: 'low', name: 'below 150 Hz', lo: 20, hi: 150 },
    { id: 'mid', name: '150 Hz–2 kHz', lo: 150, hi: 2000 },
    { id: 'pres', name: '2–5 kHz', lo: 2000, hi: 5000 },
    { id: 'high', name: '5–12 kHz', lo: 5000, hi: 12000 }
  ];
  var CHECK_DEFAULTS = { sfxPeak: -6, sfxLoud: -18, bgmLoud: -22, outlier: 6, harsh: -24, piercing: -26, boom: -16, jump: 10, mixLoud: -10, others: true };
  var check = { running: false, result: null, showIgnored: false };

  function checkSettings() {
    if (!lib.check) {
      var sfxT = [], bgmT = [];
      client().assets.forEach(function (a) {
        if (a.track < 0) return;
        var arr = a.kind === 'sfx' ? sfxT : bgmT;
        if (arr.indexOf(a.track) < 0) arr.push(a.track);
      });
      lib.check = { sfx: sfxT.length ? sfxT : [1, 2], bgm: bgmT.length ? bgmT : [3] };
      lib.check.bgm = lib.check.bgm.filter(function (t) { return lib.check.sfx.indexOf(t) < 0; });
    }
    Object.keys(CHECK_DEFAULTS).forEach(function (k) { if (lib.check[k] == null) lib.check[k] = CHECK_DEFAULTS[k]; });
    return lib.check;
  }

  function gainAt(c, t) {
    var k = c.keys;
    if (!k || !k.length) return c.db;
    if (t <= k[0][0]) return k[0][1];
    for (var i = 1; i < k.length; i++) {
      if (t <= k[i][0]) {
        var span = k[i][0] - k[i - 1][0] || 1;
        return k[i - 1][1] + (k[i][1] - k[i - 1][1]) * ((t - k[i - 1][0]) / span);
      }
    }
    return k[k.length - 1][1];
  }

  // ----- FFT (radix-2, 2048 points) -----
  var FFT_N = 2048, fftTab = null;
  function fftSetup() {
    if (fftTab) return fftTab;
    var n = FFT_N, bits = Math.round(Math.log(n) / Math.LN2), rev = new Uint32Array(n);
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var r = 0, x = i; for (var b = 0; b < bits; b++) { r = (r << 1) | (x & 1); x >>= 1; } rev[i] = r; }
    var cos = new Float64Array(n / 2), sin = new Float64Array(n / 2);
    for (i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) { cos[i] = Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / n); sin[i] = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * i / n); }
    var win = new Float64Array(n), w2 = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { win[i] = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / (n - 1)); w2 += win[i] * win[i]; }
    return (fftTab = { rev: rev, cos: cos, sin: sin, win: win, w2: w2 });
  }
  function fft(frame, re, im) {
    var t = fftSetup(), n = FFT_N, i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { re[t.rev[i]] = frame[i] * t.win[i]; im[t.rev[i]] = 0; }
    for (var size = 2; size <= n; size <<= 1) {
      var half = size >> 1, step = n / size;
      for (var s = 0; s < n; s += size) {
        for (var j = 0; j < half; j++) {
          var k = j * step, wr = t.cos[k], wi = -t.sin[k], a = s + j, b = a + half;
          var tr = re[b] * wr - im[b] * wi, ti = re[b] * wi + im[b] * wr;
          re[b] = re[a] - tr; im[b] = im[a] - ti; re[a] += tr; im[a] += ti;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Per 100 ms block of a file: mean square, peak and energy in each frequency band (cached).
  var profCache = {};
  function bandProfile(path) {
    if (profCache[path]) return Promise.resolve(profCache[path]);
    return decode(path).then(function (buf) {
      var sr = buf.sampleRate, ch = buf.numberOfChannels, n = buf.length, hop = Math.round(sr * 0.1);
      var data = [], c; for (c = 0; c < ch; c++) data.push(buf.getChannelData(c));
      var nb = Math.ceil(n / hop);
      var ms = new Float32Array(nb), pk = new Float32Array(nb), bands = BANDS.map(function () { return new Float32Array(nb); });
      var t = fftSetup(), frame = new Float64Array(FFT_N), re = new Float64Array(FFT_N), im = new Float64Array(FFT_N);
      var bins = BANDS.map(function (b) {
        return [Math.max(1, Math.round(b.lo * FFT_N / sr)), Math.min(FFT_N / 2, Math.round(b.hi * FFT_N / sr))];
      });
      var norm = 2 / (FFT_N * t.w2);
      for (var bi = 0; bi < nb; bi++) {
        var s0 = bi * hop, s1 = Math.min(n, s0 + hop), sum = 0, peak = 0, i;
