        for (i = s0; i < s1; i++) {
          for (c = 0; c < ch; c++) { var x = data[c][i]; sum += x * x; var ax = x < 0 ? -x : x; if (ax > peak) peak = ax; }
        }
        ms[bi] = sum / Math.max(1, (s1 - s0) * ch); pk[bi] = peak;
        var c0 = s0 + ((hop - FFT_N) >> 1);
        for (i = 0; i < FFT_N; i++) {
          var idx = c0 + i, v = 0;
          if (idx >= 0 && idx < n) { for (c = 0; c < ch; c++) v += data[c][idx]; v /= ch; }
          frame[i] = v;
        }
        fft(frame, re, im);
        for (var k = 0; k < BANDS.length; k++) {
          var e = 0;
          for (var q2 = bins[k][0]; q2 < bins[k][1]; q2++) e += re[q2] * re[q2] + im[q2] * im[q2];
          bands[k][bi] = e * norm;
        }
      }
      return (profCache[path] = { hop: hop / sr, ms: ms, pk: pk, bands: bands });
    });
  }

  function dB10(x) { return x > 1e-12 ? 10 * Math.log10(x) : -120; }
  // Loudest 400 ms window (4 blocks) of a mean-square series, in dB.
  function maxShortTerm(arr) {
    var best = -120;
    for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
      var sum = 0, cnt = 0;
      for (var j = i; j < Math.min(arr.length, i + 4); j++) { sum += arr[j]; cnt++; }
      best = Math.max(best, dB10(sum / cnt));
    }
    return Math.round(best * 10) / 10;
  }

  // Peak, loudness and band levels as heard, i.e. with the clip's volume (and keyframes) applied.
  function measure(c, prof) {
    var b0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(c.srcIn / prof.hop)), b1 = Math.min(prof.ms.length, Math.ceil(c.srcOut / prof.hop));
    var peak = -120, msArr = [], bandArr = BANDS.map(function () { return []; });
    for (var b = b0; b < b1; b++) {
      var lin2 = Math.pow(10, gainAt(c, Math.max(0, b * prof.hop - c.srcIn)) / 10);
      var p = prof.pk[b] * Math.sqrt(lin2);
      if (p > 0) peak = Math.max(peak, 20 * Math.log10(p));
      msArr.push(prof.ms[b] * lin2);
      for (var k = 0; k < BANDS.length; k++) bandArr[k].push(prof.bands[k][b] * lin2);
    }
    return { peak: Math.round(peak * 10) / 10, loud: maxShortTerm(msArr), band: bandArr.map(maxShortTerm) };
  }

  // Sums every clip into one timeline so moments in the overall mix can be checked.
  function mixAnalysis(items, meta) {
    var hop = 0.1, n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((meta.outS - meta.inS) / hop));
    var ms = new Float64Array(n), bands = BANDS.map(function () { return new Float64Array(n); });
    var top = new Int32Array(n).fill(-1), topV = new Float64Array(n), topP = new Int32Array(n).fill(-1), topPV = new Float64Array(n);
    items.forEach(function (c, ci) {
      var p = c.prof; if (!p) return;
      var m0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((c.start - meta.inS) / hop)), m1 = Math.min(n, Math.ceil((c.end - meta.inS) / hop));
      for (var m = m0; m < m1; m++) {
        var t = meta.inS + m * hop; if (t < c.start - 1e-6 || t >= c.end) continue;
        var rel = t - c.start, sb = Math.floor((c.srcIn + rel) / p.hop);
        if (sb < 0 || sb >= p.ms.length) continue;
        var lin2 = Math.pow(10, gainAt(c, rel) / 10), v = p.ms[sb] * lin2;
        ms[m] += v; if (v > topV[m]) { topV[m] = v; top[m] = ci; }
        for (var k = 0; k < BANDS.length; k++) {
          var bv = p.bands[k][sb] * lin2; bands[k][m] += bv;
          if (k === 2 && bv > topPV[m]) { topPV[m] = bv; topP[m] = ci; }
        }
      }
    });
    function st(arr) {
      var out = new Float32Array(n);
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var s = 0, c2 = 0; for (var j = i; j < Math.min(n, i + 4); j++) { s += arr[j]; c2++; } out[i] = dB10(s / c2); }
      return out;
    }
    return { n: n, hop: hop, L: st(ms), P: st(bands[2]), top: top, topV: topV, topP: topP, topPV: topPV };
  }

  // A jump only matters once the mix is loud enough to notice.
  var JUMP_FLOOR = -24;
  // The clip doing most of the work in the 400 ms window starting at block m.
  function culprit(mix, m, harsh) {
    var arrI = harsh ? mix.topP : mix.top, arrV = harsh ? mix.topPV : mix.topV, best = -1, bv = -1, bm = m;
    for (var j = m; j < Math.min(mix.n, m + 4); j++) if (arrI[j] >= 0 && arrV[j] > bv) { bv = arrV[j]; best = arrI[j]; bm = j; }
    return { ci: best, m: bm };
  }
  function mixEvents(mix, s) {
    var L = mix.L, P = mix.P, n = mix.n, cands = { jump: [], loud: [], harsh: [] };
    for (var m = 0; m < n; m++) {
      if (L[m] > JUMP_FLOOR) {
        var prev = [];
        for (var j = Math.max(0, m - 30); j < m - 4; j++) if (L[j] > -70) prev.push(L[j]);
        if (prev.length >= 8) {
          prev.sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
          var base = prev[Math.floor(prev.length / 2)];
          if (L[m] - base > s.jump) cands.jump.push({ m: m, v: L[m], by: L[m] - base });
        }
      }
      if (L[m] > s.mixLoud) cands.loud.push({ m: m, v: L[m] });
      if (P[m] > s.harsh) cands.harsh.push({ m: m, v: P[m] });
    }
    var out = [];
    Object.keys(cands).forEach(function (kind) {
      var g = null;
      cands[kind].forEach(function (c) {
        if (g && c.m - g.last <= 5) { g.last = c.m; if (c.v > g.best.v) g.best = c; }
        else { if (g) out.push({ kind: kind, c: g.best }); g = { last: c.m, best: c }; }
      });
      if (g) out.push({ kind: kind, c: g.best });
    });
    return out;
  }

  function ignoreKey(meta, c) { return meta.seqId + '|' + c.track + '|' + Math.round(c.start * 100) + '|' + c.path; }

  function evaluate() {
    var r = check.result, s = checkSettings(), items = r.items, meta = r.meta;
    var sfx = items.filter(function (it) { return it.role === 'sfx' && !it.unreadable; });
    var sorted = sfx.map(function (it) { return it.loud; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
    var median = sorted.length ? sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)] : null;
    items.forEach(function (it) {
      it.reasons = []; it.metric = null;
      if (it.unreadable || it.role === 'other') return;
      var add = function (text, label, value, limit) { it.reasons.push(text); if (!it.metric) it.metric = { label: label, value: value, limit: limit }; };
      if (it.role === 'sfx') {
        if (it.peak > s.sfxPeak) add('Peaks at ' + fmtDb(it.peak) + '. Your limit is ' + fmtDb(s.sfxPeak) + '.', 'Peak', it.peak, s.sfxPeak);
        if (it.loud > s.sfxLoud) add('Loudness ' + fmtDb(it.loud) + '. Your limit is ' + fmtDb(s.sfxLoud) + '.', 'Loudness', it.loud, s.sfxLoud);
        if (sorted.length >= 3 && it.loud > median + s.outlier) {
          add(Math.round(it.loud - median) + ' dB louder than your other SFX here (typical ' + fmtDb(median) + ').', 'Loudness', it.loud, median + s.outlier);
        }
        if (it.band[0] > s.boom) add('Heavy low end ' + BANDS[0].name + ' at ' + fmtDb(it.band[0]) + ' (boomy). Your limit is ' + fmtDb(s.boom) + '.', 'Lows', it.band[0], s.boom);
      } else if (it.loud > s.bgmLoud) {
        add('Music bed at ' + fmtDb(it.loud) + '. Your limit is ' + fmtDb(s.bgmLoud) + '.', 'Loudness', it.loud, s.bgmLoud);
      }
      if (it.band[2] > s.harsh) add('Harsh ' + BANDS[2].name + ' at ' + fmtDb(it.band[2]) + ' (sharp, tiring). Your limit is ' + fmtDb(s.harsh) + '.', '2–5 kHz', it.band[2], s.harsh);
      if (it.band[3] > s.piercing) add('Piercing highs ' + BANDS[3].name + ' at ' + fmtDb(it.band[3]) + '. Your limit is ' + fmtDb(s.piercing) + '.', '5–12 kHz', it.band[3], s.piercing);
    });

    r.mix = mixAnalysis(items, meta);
    r.events = [];
    mixEvents(r.mix, s).forEach(function (ev) {
      var who = culprit(r.mix, ev.c.m, ev.kind === 'harsh');
      var t = meta.inS + who.m * r.mix.hop, c = who.ci >= 0 ? items[who.ci] : null;
      var text, limit;
      if (ev.kind === 'jump') { text = 'The whole mix jumps ' + Math.round(ev.c.by) + ' dB above the 3 s before it.'; limit = ev.c.v - ev.c.by + s.jump; }
      else if (ev.kind === 'loud') { text = 'The whole mix reaches ' + fmtDb(ev.c.v) + '. Your limit is ' + fmtDb(s.mixLoud) + '.'; limit = s.mixLoud; }
      else { text = 'Harsh ' + BANDS[2].name + ' build-up in the mix: ' + fmtDb(ev.c.v) + '. Your limit is ' + fmtDb(s.harsh) + '.'; limit = s.harsh; }
      // A clip already listed gets this as one more reason instead of a separate card.
      if (c && c.reasons && c.reasons.length && c.role !== 'other' && t >= c.start - 0.05 && t <= c.end + 0.05) {
        // Its own loudness/harshness reasons already cover the mix level; only add the jump.
        if (ev.kind === 'jump' && c.reasons.indexOf(text) < 0) c.reasons.push(text);
        return;
      }
      r.events.push({
        kind: ev.kind, t: t, value: ev.c.v, limit: limit, text: text, clip: c,
        key: meta.seqId + '|mix|' + ev.kind + '|' + Math.round(t * 2)
      });
    });
  }

  function chipsHtml(role, s) {
    var on = s[role], html = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < seqTracks; i++) {
      html += '<button class="chip' + (on.indexOf(i) >= 0 ? ' on ' + role : '') + '" data-act="chip" data-role="' + role +
        '" data-i="' + i + '" aria-pressed="' + (on.indexOf(i) >= 0) + '">A' + (i + 1) + '</button>';
    }
    return html;
  }

  function limitRow(label, k, s) {
    return '<div class="lim"><span>' + label + '</span><input type="number" step="0.5" data-k="' + k + '" value="' + s[k] + '"><span>dB</span></div>';
  }

  function renderCheck() {
    var s = checkSettings();
    $('#check').innerHTML = '' +
      '<div class="ck-setup">' +
        '<p class="ck-intro">Set In and Out on the timeline, then run the check. It listens to every clip in that range at the volume set on it: loudness, harsh frequencies, and sudden loud beats in the whole mix.</p>' +
        '<div class="ck-row"><label>SFX tracks</label><div class="chips">' + chipsHtml('sfx', s) + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class="ck-row"><label>BGM tracks</label><div class="chips">' + chipsHtml('bgm', s) + '</div></div>' +
        '<label class="set-check"><input type="checkbox" data-act="others"' + (s.others ? ' checked' : '') + '> Include all other tracks (voice, extra music) in the whole mix</label>' +
        '<details class="limits"><summary>Limits</summary>' +
          '<div class="lim-group">Each clip</div>' +
          limitRow('SFX peaks above', 'sfxPeak', s) +
          limitRow('SFX loudness above', 'sfxLoud', s) +
          limitRow('SFX louder than the others by', 'outlier', s) +
          limitRow('BGM loudness above', 'bgmLoud', s) +
          '<div class="lim-group">Frequencies</div>' +
          limitRow('Harsh 2–5 kHz above', 'harsh', s) +
          limitRow('Piercing 5–12 kHz above', 'piercing', s) +
          limitRow('SFX lows below 150 Hz above', 'boom', s) +
          '<div class="lim-group">Whole mix</div>' +
          limitRow('Sudden jump of more than', 'jump', s) +
          limitRow('Mix loudness above', 'mixLoud', s) +
        '</details>' +
        '<button class="run" data-act="run"' + (check.running ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + (check.running ? 'Checking…' : 'Check In to Out') + '</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div id="ckResults">' + resultsHtml() + '</div>';
    if (check.result && check.result.mix) drawMixGraph();
  }

  function meterHtml(value, limit) {
    var pct = faderPct(value), lim = faderPct(limit);
    return '<div class="meter"><div class="meter-fill' + (value > limit ? ' over' : '') + '" style="width:' + pct + '%"></div>' +
      '<div class="meter-limit" style="left:' + lim + '%" title="Limit ' + fmtDb(limit) + '"></div></div>';
  }

  function issueHtml(x, meta) {
    var isMix = !!x.isMix, ign = !!lib.ignored[x.key];
    var tc = timecode(isMix ? x.t : x.start, meta.fps);
    var name = isMix ? 'Whole mix' : x.name;
    var sub = isMix && x.clip ? '<div class="from">Mostly from ' + esc(x.clip.name) + ' on A' + (x.clip.track + 1) + '</div>' : '';
    var metric = isMix ? { label: 'Mix', value: x.value, limit: x.limit } : x.metric;
    var reasons = isMix ? [x.text] : x.reasons;
    return '<div class="issue ' + (isMix ? 'mix' : x.role) + (ign ? ' ignored' : '') + '" data-k="' + esc(x.key) + '">' +
      '<div class="issue-top"><span class="tc">' + tc + '</span>' +
        '<span class="name" title="' + esc(name) + '">' + esc(name) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="badge">' + (isMix ? 'Mix' : 'A' + (x.track + 1)) + '</span></div>' + sub +
      (metric ? '<div class="issue-meter">' + meterHtml(metric.value, metric.limit) +
        '<span class="mv">' + metric.label + ' ' + fmtDb(metric.value) + '</span></div>' : '') +
      '<ul class="why">' + reasons.map(function (t) { return '<li>' + esc(t) + '</li>'; }).join('') + '</ul>' +
      '<div class="issue-actions">' +
        '<button data-act="goto">Go to</button>' +
        (isMix && !x.clip ? '' : '<button data-act="lower">−3 dB' + (isMix ? ' on that clip' : '') + '</button>') +
        '<span class="spacer"></span>' +
        (ign ? '<button class="mini" data-act="unignore">Unignore</button>' : '<button class="mini" data-act="ignore">Ignore</button>') +
      '</div></div>';
  }

  function resultsHtml() {
    var r = check.result;
    if (!r) return '';
    if (r.error) return '<div class="ck-empty err">' + esc(r.error) + '</div>';
    var meta = r.meta;
    var all = r.items.filter(function (it) { return it.reasons && it.reasons.length; })
      .concat(r.events.map(function (ev) { ev.isMix = true; return ev; }));
    all.sort(function (a, b) { return (a.isMix ? a.t : a.start) - (b.isMix ? b.t : b.start); });
    var open = all.filter(function (x) { return !lib.ignored[x.key]; });
    var ignored = all.filter(function (x) { return lib.ignored[x.key]; });
    var range = meta.whole ? 'the whole sequence (no In/Out set)' : timecode(meta.inS, meta.fps) + '–' + timecode(meta.outS, meta.fps);
    var tracks = {}; r.items.forEach(function (it) { tracks[it.track] = 1; });
    var unread = r.items.filter(function (it) { return it.unreadable; }).length;
    var head = '<div class="ck-summary">' +
      '<b>' + (open.length ? open.length + ' thing' + (open.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' to review' : 'Nothing disturbing found') + '</b>' +
      '<span>Checked ' + r.items.length + ' clip' + (r.items.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' on ' + Object.keys(tracks).length + ' track' +
        (Object.keys(tracks).length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' in ' + range + '.' + (unread ? ' ' + unread + ' couldn’t be read.' : '') + '</span></div>';
    var graph = '<div class="mixbox"><canvas id="mixGraph"></canvas>' +
      '<div class="mix-legend"><span class="lg-line"></span>Whole mix loudness<span class="lg-area"></span>2–5 kHz<span class="lg-mark"></span>Flagged</div>' +
      '<div class="mix-hint" id="mixHint">Click the graph to move the playhead there.</div></div>';
    var shown = check.showIgnored ? all : open;
    var cards = shown.map(function (x) { return issueHtml(x, meta); }).join('');
    var toggle = ignored.length
      ? '<button class="mini ck-toggle" data-act="toggleIgnored">' + (check.showIgnored ? 'Hide' : 'Show') + ' ' + ignored.length + ' ignored</button>' : '';
    var none = !open.length && !check.showIgnored
      ? '<div class="ck-empty">Every clip and the whole mix are within your limits in this range.</div>' : '';
    return head + graph + cards + none + toggle;
  }

  function drawMixGraph() {
    var cv = document.getElementById('mixGraph'), r = check.result;
    if (!cv || !r || !r.mix) return;
    var box = cv.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect(), dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var W = Math.max(50, Math.floor(box.width - 2)), H = 96;
    cv.width = W * dpr; cv.height = H * dpr; cv.style.width = W + 'px'; cv.style.height = H + 'px';
    var g = cv.getContext('2d'); g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    g.fillStyle = '#1b1b1b'; g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    var mix = r.mix, n = mix.n, TOP = 0, BOT = -60, s = checkSettings();
    var y = function (db) { return 4 + (TOP - clamp(db, BOT, TOP)) / (TOP - BOT) * (H - 8); };
    var x = function (m) { return (m / Math.max(1, n - 1)) * W; };
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.08)'; g.lineWidth = 1;
    [-12, -24, -36, -48].forEach(function (db) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, Math.round(y(db)) + 0.5); g.lineTo(W, Math.round(y(db)) + 0.5); g.stroke(); });
    // 2–5 kHz area
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, H);
    for (var m = 0; m < n; m++) g.lineTo(x(m), y(mix.P[m]));
    g.lineTo(W, H); g.closePath(); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(243,154,47,.35)'; g.fill();
    // limit
    g.setLineDash([3, 3]); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(229,96,90,.7)';
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, Math.round(y(s.mixLoud)) + 0.5); g.lineTo(W, Math.round(y(s.mixLoud)) + 0.5); g.stroke(); g.setLineDash([]);
    // loudness line
    g.strokeStyle = '#ececec'; g.lineWidth = 1.3; g.beginPath();
    for (m = 0; m < n; m++) { if (m) g.lineTo(x(m), y(mix.L[m])); else g.moveTo(x(m), y(mix.L[m])); }
    g.stroke();
    // flagged moments
    var marks = r.items.filter(function (it) { return it.reasons && it.reasons.length; }).map(function (it) { return { t: it.start, key: it.key }; })
      .concat(r.events.map(function (ev) { return { t: ev.t, key: ev.key }; }));
    marks.forEach(function (mk) {
      var xx = Math.round(((mk.t - r.meta.inS) / (r.meta.outS - r.meta.inS)) * W) + 0.5;
      g.fillStyle = lib.ignored[mk.key] ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)' : '#e5605a';
      g.fillRect(xx - 0.5, 0, 1.5, H);
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(xx - 4, 0); g.lineTo(xx + 4, 0); g.lineTo(xx, 6); g.closePath(); g.fill();
    });
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.45)'; g.font = '10px -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif'; g.textBaseline = 'bottom';
    g.fillText(timecode(r.meta.inS, r.meta.fps), 3, H - 2);
    var endTc = timecode(r.meta.outS, r.meta.fps); g.fillText(endTc, W - g.measureText(endTc).width - 3, H - 2);
  }

  function runCheck() {
    var s = checkSettings();
    if (!s.sfx.length && !s.bgm.length && !s.others) { setStatus('Pick at least one track to check.', 'err'); return; }
    check.running = true; check.result = null; renderCheck();
    setStatus('Reading clips between In and Out…');
    hostJson('FrameshiftSK.scan(' + q(s.sfx.join(',')) + ',' + q(s.bgm.join(',')) + ',' + (s.others ? 'true' : 'false') + ')').then(function (meta) {
      seqTracks = Math.max(1, meta.tracks || seqTracks);
      var items = meta.clips.map(function (c) { c.key = ignoreKey(meta, c); return c; });
      var paths = []; items.forEach(function (c) { if (paths.indexOf(c.path) < 0) paths.push(c.path); });
      var i = 0;
      function next() {
        if (i >= paths.length) return Promise.resolve();
        var p = paths[i++];
        setStatus('Listening to file ' + i + ' of ' + paths.length + ': ' + baseName(p) + '…');
        return bandProfile(p).catch(function () {}).then(next);
      }
      return next().then(function () {
        items.forEach(function (c) {
          c.prof = profCache[c.path];
          if (!c.prof) { c.unreadable = true; return; }
          var m = measure(c, c.prof); c.peak = m.peak; c.loud = m.loud; c.band = m.band;
        });
        check.result = { meta: meta, items: items };
        evaluate();
        var n = openCount();
        setStatus(items.length ? (n ? n + ' thing' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' to review.' : 'All ' + items.length + ' clips and the whole mix are within your limits.')
          : 'No clips on those tracks between In and Out.', n ? 'err' : 'ok');
      });
    }).catch(function (e) {
      check.result = { error: e.message }; setStatus(e.message, 'err');
    }).then(function () { check.running = false; renderCheck(); });
  }

  function openCount() {
    var r = check.result; if (!r || !r.items) return 0;
    return r.items.filter(function (it) { return it.reasons && it.reasons.length && !lib.ignored[it.key]; }).length +
      r.events.filter(function (ev) { return !lib.ignored[ev.key]; }).length;
  }

  function findIssue(key) {
    var r = check.result; if (!r) return null;
    return r.items.find(function (x) { return x.key === key; }) || r.events.find(function (x) { return x.key === key; });
  }

  var ckBox = $('#check');
  ckBox.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var cv = e.target.closest('#mixGraph');
    if (cv && check.result) {
      var rect = cv.getBoundingClientRect(), meta = check.result.meta;
      var t = meta.inS + clamp((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width, 0, 1) * (meta.outS - meta.inS);
      host('FrameshiftSK.gotoTime(' + t + ')').then(function () { setStatus('Playhead at ' + timecode(t, meta.fps) + '.', 'ok'); });
      return;
    }
    var btn = e.target.closest('button, input[data-act]'); if (!btn) return;
    var act = btn.dataset.act, s = checkSettings();
    if (act === 'run') { runCheck(); return; }
    if (act === 'others') { s.others = btn.checked; save(); return; }
    if (act === 'chip') {
      var role = btn.dataset.role, other = role === 'sfx' ? 'bgm' : 'sfx', tr = Number(btn.dataset.i);
      var arr = s[role], at = arr.indexOf(tr);
      if (at >= 0) arr.splice(at, 1); else { arr.push(tr); var o = s[other].indexOf(tr); if (o >= 0) s[other].splice(o, 1); }
      save(); renderCheck(); return;
    }
    if (act === 'toggleIgnored') { check.showIgnored = !check.showIgnored; renderCheck(); return; }
    var card = btn.closest('.issue'); if (!card || !check.result) return;
    var x = findIssue(card.dataset.k); if (!x) return;
    var fps = check.result.meta.fps, clip = x.isMix ? x.clip : x, t = x.isMix ? x.t : x.start;
    var tc = timecode(t, fps);
    if (act === 'goto') {
      var go = clip ? host('FrameshiftSK.gotoClip(' + clip.track + ',' + clip.start + ')') : Promise.resolve('OK|0');
      go.then(function (r1) {
        return (x.isMix ? host('FrameshiftSK.gotoTime(' + t + ')') : Promise.resolve(r1)).then(function (r2b) {
          if (r2b.indexOf('OK|') !== 0) { setStatus(r2b.split('|').slice(1).join('|'), 'err'); return; }
          setStatus('Playhead at ' + tc + (clip && r1 === 'OK|1' ? ', ' + clip.name + ' selected on A' + (clip.track + 1) + '.' : '.'), 'ok');
        });
      });
    } else if (act === 'lower' && clip) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      hostJson('FrameshiftSK.adjustClip(' + clip.track + ',' + clip.start + ',-3)').then(function (v) {
        clip.db = v.db; clip.keys = v.keys;
        var m = measure(clip, clip.prof); clip.peak = m.peak; clip.loud = m.loud; clip.band = m.band;
        evaluate(); renderCheck();
        var still = findIssue(card.dataset.k);
        var left = still && (still.isMix || (still.reasons && still.reasons.length));
        setStatus('Lowered ' + clip.name + ' by 3 dB' + (left ? '. Still above your limits here.' : '. Now within your limits.'), left ? 'err' : 'ok');
      }).catch(function (e2) { setStatus(e2.message, 'err'); btn.disabled = false; });
    } else if (act === 'ignore') {
      lib.ignored[x.key] = Date.now(); save(); renderCheck();
      setStatus('Ignored ' + (x.isMix ? 'the mix moment' : x.name) + ' at ' + tc + '. It won’t be flagged again in this sequence.');
    } else if (act === 'unignore') {
      delete lib.ignored[x.key]; save(); renderCheck();
      setStatus('Unignored ' + (x.isMix ? 'the mix moment' : x.name) + '.');
    }
  });
  ckBox.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    var cv = e.target.closest('#mixGraph'), hint = document.getElementById('mixHint');
    if (!cv || !hint || !check.result || !check.result.mix) return;
    var rect = cv.getBoundingClientRect(), r = check.result, f = clamp((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width, 0, 1);
    var m = Math.min(r.mix.n - 1, Math.round(f * (r.mix.n - 1)));
    hint.textContent = timecode(r.meta.inS + f * (r.meta.outS - r.meta.inS), r.meta.fps) + ' · mix ' + fmtDb(r.mix.L[m]) + ' · 2–5 kHz ' + fmtDb(r.mix.P[m]);
  });
  ckBox.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
    var k = e.target.dataset.k; if (!k) return;
    var v = parseFloat(e.target.value);
    if (isNaN(v)) { e.target.value = checkSettings()[k]; return; }
    checkSettings()[k] = v; save();
    if (check.result && check.result.items) { evaluate(); $('#ckResults').innerHTML = resultsHtml(); drawMixGraph(); }
  });

  // =====================================================================
  // Library folder: client-wise WAVs with the volume baked in + client.json
  // =====================================================================
  var FOLDERS = { sfx: 'SFX', part: 'BGM parts', bgm: 'Full BGM' };
  function settings() {
    if (!lib.settings) lib.settings = { root: '', autoSync: true };
    return lib.settings;
  }
  function safeName(s) { return String(s || 'Untitled').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '-').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 80) || 'Untitled'; }
  function dbTag(db) { var n = Math.round(db * 10) / 10; return (n > 0 ? '+' : '') + n + 'dB'; }
  function clientDir(c) { return nodePath.join(settings().root, safeName(c.name)); }
  function libraryOn() { return !!(nodeFs && settings().root); }
  function inside(dir, p) { return p && nodePath.resolve(p).toLowerCase().indexOf(nodePath.resolve(dir).toLowerCase()) === 0; }
  function mkdirp(d) { if (!nodeFs.existsSync(d)) nodeFs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true }); }

  // Gain already in the source file (for sounds imported from a shared folder).
  // What Premiere says about the clip's colour after placing (the jsx returns it as the last field).
  function colourNote(r) {
    var p = String(r || '').split('|'), c = p[p.length - 1];
    if (c === 'nolabel') return ' (couldn\u2019t colour the clip; set its label by hand)';
    if (/^got:\d+$/.test(c)) return ' (Premiere shows it as ' + (LABELS[Number(c.slice(4))] || { name: '#' + c.slice(4) }).name + ')';
    return '';
  }
  function clipDb(a) { return Number(a.db) - (a.bakedDb || 0); }
  // Frameshift: Full BGM fades in and out (seconds; default 1 s in, 2 s out). Returns the volume
  // keyframes for a clip `len` seconds long as "t:db;t:db", or '' for no fades.
  function bgmFadeKeys(a, len) {
    if (a.kind !== 'bgm' || !(len > 0)) return '';
    var fi = a.fadeIn == null ? 1 : Math.max(0, Number(a.fadeIn) || 0), fo = a.fadeOut == null ? 2 : Math.max(0, Number(a.fadeOut) || 0);
    if (!fi && !fo) return '';
    if (fi + fo > len) { var k = len / (fi + fo); fi *= k; fo *= k; }
    var db = clipDb(a), keys = [];
    if (fi) keys.push([0, MIN_DB], [fi, db]); else keys.push([0, db]);
    if (fo) keys.push([len - fo, db], [len, MIN_DB]); else keys.push([len, db]);
    keys = keys.filter(function (x, i) { return !i || Math.abs(x[0] - keys[i - 1][0]) > 0.0005; }); // short clip: fades meet
    return keys.map(function (x) { return (Math.round(x[0] * 1000) / 1000) + ':' + x[1]; }).join(';');
  }

  function encodeWav(chs, sr, useFloat) {
    var nCh = chs.length, n = chs[0].length, bps = useFloat ? 4 : 3, block = nCh * bps, dataLen = n * block;
    var fmtLen = useFloat ? 18 : 16, factLen = useFloat ? 12 : 0;
    var total = 12 + 8 + fmtLen + factLen + 8 + dataLen;
    var ab = new ArrayBuffer(total), v = new DataView(ab), o = 0;
    function str(s) { for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) v.setUint8(o++, s.charCodeAt(i)); }
    function u16(x) { v.setUint16(o, x, true); o += 2; }
    function u32(x) { v.setUint32(o, x, true); o += 4; }
    str('RIFF'); u32(total - 8); str('WAVE');
    str('fmt '); u32(fmtLen); u16(useFloat ? 3 : 1); u16(nCh); u32(sr); u32(sr * block); u16(block); u16(bps * 8);
    if (useFloat) { u16(0); str('fact'); u32(4); u32(n); }
    str('data'); u32(dataLen);
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      for (var c = 0; c < nCh; c++) {
        var x = chs[c][i];
        if (useFloat) { v.setFloat32(o, x, true); o += 4; }
        else {
          var s = Math.round(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, x)) * 8388607);
          v.setUint8(o, s & 255); v.setUint8(o + 1, (s >> 8) & 255); v.setUint8(o + 2, (s >> 16) & 255); o += 3;
        }
      }
    }
    return ab;
  }

  // Applies the sound's level (or BGM-part keyframes) to the audio, ready to drop in at 0 dB.
  function renderBaked(a, buf) {
    return renderRange(a, buf, a.kind === 'part' ? a.in : 0, a.kind === 'part' ? a.out : 0);
  }


  function bakedFileName(a) { return safeName(a.name) + ' [' + volTag(a) + '].wav'; }


  var bakeChain = Promise.resolve();
  function bakeAsset(a, c) {
    if (!libraryOn() || !fileExists(a.path)) return Promise.resolve();
    bakeChain = bakeChain.then(function () {
      return decode(a.path).then(function (buf) {
        var dir = nodePath.join(clientDir(c), FOLDERS[a.kind]);
        mkdirp(dir);
        var dest = nodePath.join(dir, bakedFileName(a));
        // Don't overwrite another sound's file that happens to share the name.
        var taken = c.assets.some(function (o) { return o !== a && o.exportFile && nodePath.resolve(o.exportFile) === nodePath.resolve(dest); });
        if (taken) dest = dest.replace(/\.wav$/, ' (' + a.id.slice(-4) + ').wav');
        var r = renderBaked(a, buf);
        nodeFs.writeFileSync(dest, new Uint8Array(encodeWav(r.chs, r.sr, r.useFloat)));
        var old = a.exportFile;
        if (old && nodePath.resolve(old) !== nodePath.resolve(dest) && nodePath.resolve(old) !== nodePath.resolve(a.path) &&
            inside(settings().root, old) && nodeFs.existsSync(old)) {
          try { nodeFs.unlinkSync(old); } catch (e) {}
        }
        a.exportFile = dest;
      });
    }).catch(function (e) {
      setStatus('Couldn’t save ' + a.name + ' to the library folder: ' + e.message, 'err');
    }).then(function () { writeClientJson(c); save(); });
    return bakeChain;
  }

  function removeBaked(a, c) {
    if (!libraryOn()) return;
    if (a.exportFile && nodePath.resolve(a.exportFile) !== nodePath.resolve(a.path) && inside(settings().root, a.exportFile)) {
      try { if (nodeFs.existsSync(a.exportFile)) nodeFs.unlinkSync(a.exportFile); } catch (e) {}
    }
    writeClientJson(c);
  }

  function writeClientJson(c) {
    if (!libraryOn()) return;
    var dir = clientDir(c);
    try {
      mkdirp(dir);
      var data = {
        cskClientFolder: 1, client: c.name, savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        note: 'Every WAV here already includes the volume listed. Drop them in at 0 dB. Folder made by Client Sound Kit for Premiere Pro.',
        sounds: c.assets.filter(function (a) { return a.exportFile; }).map(function (a) {
          var o = {
            name: a.name, type: a.kind, file: nodePath.relative(dir, a.exportFile).replace(/\\/g, '/'),
            track: trackLabel(a.track), trackIndex: a.track, color: LABELS[a.color].name, colorIndex: a.color
          };
          if (a.kind === 'part') { o.section = a.tag; o.lengthSec = Math.round(partLen(a) * 1000) / 1000; o.keyframes = a.keys; o.volumeDb = a.keys.length ? null : a.db; }
          else o.volumeDb = a.db;
          if (a.kind === 'sfx' && a.wave && a.wave.onsets) { o.beats = a.wave.onsets; o.beatSensitivity = a.wave.sens; }
          return o;
        })
      };
      nodeFs.writeFileSync(nodePath.join(dir, 'client.json'), JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), 'utf8');
    } catch (e) { setStatus('Couldn’t write client.json: ' + e.message, 'err'); }
  }

  function syncClient(c) {
    var jobs = c.assets.map(function (a) { return bakeAsset(a, c); });
    return Promise.all(jobs).then(function () { writeClientJson(c); });
  }

  function afterAssetChange(a) { if (libraryOn() && settings().autoSync) bakeAsset(a, client()); }

  function importClientFolder() {
    if (!nodeFs || !window.cep) { setStatus('Import works inside Premiere Pro.', 'err'); return; }
    var r = window.cep.fs.showOpenDialogEx(false, true, 'Choose a client folder (with client.json)', settings().root || '', []);
    var dir = r && r.data && r.data[0];
    if (!dir) return;
    importFromDir(dir);
  }

  function importFromDir(dir) {
    try {
      var data = JSON.parse(nodeFs.readFileSync(nodePath.join(dir, 'client.json'), 'utf8'));
      if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.sounds)) throw new Error('client.json isn’t from Client Sound Kit');
      var name = data.client || nodePath.basename(dir);
      if (lib.clients.some(function (c) { return c.name === name; })) name += ' (shared)';
      var c = { id: uid(), name: name, assets: [] };
      data.sounds.forEach(function (s) {
        var a = {
          id: uid(), name: s.name, kind: s.type, path: nodePath.join(dir, s.file),
          track: s.trackIndex != null ? s.trackIndex : 1, color: s.colorIndex != null ? s.colorIndex : 5
        };
        if (s.type === 'part') {
          // The fade is already in the file: place it flat, keep the shape as a label.
          a.tag = s.section || 'intro'; a.in = 0; a.out = s.lengthSec || 6; a.keys = []; a.mode = 'media';
          a.db = 0; a.bakedDb = 0;
          if (s.keyframes && s.keyframes.length) a.inFile = volLabel({ kind: 'part', keys: s.keyframes });
        } else {
          a.db = s.volumeDb != null ? s.volumeDb : 0; a.bakedDb = a.db;
          if (s.beats) a.wave = { sens: s.beatSensitivity != null ? s.beatSensitivity : 0.5 };
        }
        c.assets.push(a);
      });
      lib.clients.push(c); lib.activeClient = c.id;
      if (!['sfx', 'part', 'bgm'].includes(lib.activeKind)) lib.activeKind = 'sfx';
      save(); renderAll();
      setStatus('Imported ' + name + ' with ' + c.assets.length + ' sounds. Levels are already in the files.', 'ok');
    } catch (e) { setStatus('Couldn’t import that folder: ' + e.message, 'err'); }
  }

  function volTag(a) {
    if (a.kind === 'part' && a.keys.length > 1) return dbTag(a.keys[0][1]).replace('dB', '') + ' to ' + dbTag(a.keys[a.keys.length - 1][1]);
    if (a.kind === 'part' && a.keys.length === 1) return dbTag(a.keys[0][1]);
    return dbTag(a.db);
  }

  // [from, to) seconds of the file with the sound's level baked in (to 0 = end of file).
  function renderRange(a, buf, from, to) {
    var sr = buf.sampleRate, nCh = buf.numberOfChannels;
    var s0 = clamp(Math.floor(from * sr), 0, buf.length - 1);
    var s1 = clamp(to > from ? Math.floor(to * sr) : buf.length, s0 + 1, buf.length);
    var n = s1 - s0, chs = [], peak = 0, BLK = 64, base = a.bakedDb || 0;
    var rel0 = from - (a.kind === 'part' ? a.in : 0);
    for (var c = 0; c < nCh; c++) chs.push(new Float32Array(n));
    for (var b = 0; b < n; b += BLK) {
      var g = (a.kind === 'part' ? gainAt(a, rel0 + b / sr) : Number(a.db)) - base;
      var lin = Math.pow(10, g / 20), e = Math.min(n, b + BLK);
      for (c = 0; c < nCh; c++) {
        var src = buf.getChannelData(c), dst = chs[c];
        for (var i = b; i < e; i++) { var x = src[s0 + i] * lin; dst[i] = x; var ax = x < 0 ? -x : x; if (ax > peak) peak = ax; }
      }
    }
    return { chs: chs, sr: sr, useFloat: peak > 0.999 };
  }

  // ---------- Settings view ----------
  var syncing = false;
  function openSettings(on) {
    editing = null; stopPreview();
    view = on ? 'settings' : 'sounds';
    renderAll();
  }
  // Frameshift: the real file name (with extension), shown next to the custom name.
  var IS_WIN = (function () { try { return window.require('os').platform() === 'win32'; } catch (e) { return /Win/.test(navigator.platform || ''); } })();
  function baseFile(p) { return String(p || '').split(/[\\\/]/).pop(); }
  function revealFile(p) {
    try {
      var cp = window.require('child_process');
      if (IS_WIN) cp.exec('explorer /select,"' + p + '"'); else cp.exec('open -R "' + p.replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '"');
    } catch (err) { setStatus(p); }
  }

  // Frameshift: no duplicates. The same file (or an identical copy under another name) can be in
  // SFX or full BGM once; BGM parts may come from one song, but not cover almost the same seconds.
  function sameAudio(p1, p2) {
    if (!p1 || !p2) return false;
    if (nodePath.resolve(p1).toLowerCase() === nodePath.resolve(p2).toLowerCase()) return true;
    try {
      var s1 = nodeFs.statSync(p1), s2 = nodeFs.statSync(p2);
      if (s1.size !== s2.size) return false;
      var B = window.require('buffer').Buffer, n = Math.min(65536, s1.size), b1 = B.alloc(n), b2 = B.alloc(n), f1 = nodeFs.openSync(p1, 'r'), f2 = nodeFs.openSync(p2, 'r');
      try {
        nodeFs.readSync(f1, b1, 0, n, 0); nodeFs.readSync(f2, b2, 0, n, 0);
        if (!b1.equals(b2)) return false;
        nodeFs.readSync(f1, b1, 0, n, Math.max(0, s1.size - n)); nodeFs.readSync(f2, b2, 0, n, Math.max(0, s2.size - n));
        return b1.equals(b2);
      } finally { nodeFs.closeSync(f1); nodeFs.closeSync(f2); }
    } catch (e) { return false; }
  }
  var KIND_NAME = { sfx: 'SFX', bgm: 'Full BGM', part: 'BGM parts' };
  function duplicateOf(kind, path, inS, outS, exceptId) {
    var list = client().assets;
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      var o = list[i];
      if (o.kind !== kind || o.id === exceptId || !sameAudio(o.path, path)) continue;
      if (kind !== 'part') return o;
      var ov = Math.min(o.out, outS) - Math.max(o.in, inS), shorter = Math.min(o.out - o.in, outS - inS);
      if (shorter > 0 && ov / shorter >= 0.9) return o;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function dupMessage(o) {
    return 'Already in ' + KIND_NAME[o.kind] + ' as \u201C' + o.name + '\u201D' + (o.kind === 'part' ? ' (' + fmtClock(o.in) + '\u2013' + fmtClock(o.out) + ')' : '') + '.';
  }

  function openPath(p) {
    try {
      if (!nodeFs.existsSync(p)) mkdirp(p);
      window.require('child_process').exec((process.platform === 'win32' ? 'explorer "' : 'open "') + p + '"');
    } catch (err) { setStatus(p); }
  }

  function renderSettings() {
    var s = settings(), c = client();
    var where = s.root ? esc(s.root) : 'Not set';
    var example = esc(safeName(c.name)) + '/SFX, BGM parts, Full BGM';
    $('#settings').innerHTML = '' +
      '<div class="set">' +
        '<div class="set-head"><b>Library folder</b><button class="mini" data-act="close">Done</button></div>' +
        '<div class="set-path' + (s.root ? '' : ' empty') + '"><bdi>' + where + '</bdi></div>' +
        '<div class="set-actions">' +
          '<button class="run" data-act="choose">' + (s.root ? 'Change folder' : 'Choose folder') + '</button>' +
          (s.root ? '<button data-act="open">Open</button>' : '') +
        '</div>' +
        '<p class="set-note">Each client gets its own folder: <b>' + example + '</b>. Sounds are saved as WAV files with your volume already in them, so anyone can drop them in without touching the level. A <b>client.json</b> keeps tracks, colours, beats and keyframes.</p>' +
        '<label class="set-check"><input type="checkbox" data-act="auto"' + (s.autoSync ? ' checked' : '') + '> Update the folder whenever I add or change a sound</label>' +
        (s.root ? '<button class="wide" data-act="syncAll"' + (syncing ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + (syncing ? 'Saving…' : 'Save all clients to the folder now') + '</button>' : '') +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="set">' +
        '<b>Clients</b>' +
        '<p class="set-note">To share a client, send its folder from the library. The other person uses Import client folder to get the whole kit with tracks and colours.</p>' +
        '<div class="set-grid">' +
          '<button data-act="importFolder">Import client folder…</button>' +
          '<button data-act="duplicate">Duplicate ' + esc(c.name) + '</button>' +
          '<button data-act="export">Export client file…</button>' +
          '<button data-act="import">Import client file…</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="set">' +
        '<b>Dragging to the timeline</b>' +
        '<p class="set-note">Sounds you drag onto the timeline are saved with their volume in them here. Keep this folder, because your projects use these files.</p>' +
        '<div class="set-path"><bdi>' + esc(nodePath ? nodePath.join(LIB_DIR, 'Rendered') : 'Documents/ClientSoundKit/Rendered') + '</bdi></div>' +
        '<button class="wide" data-act="openRendered">Open folder</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  $('#settings').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var el = e.target.closest('[data-act]'); if (!el) return;
    var act = el.dataset.act, s = settings(), c = client();
    if (act === 'close') openSettings(false);
    else if (act === 'choose') {
      if (!nodeFs || !window.cep) { setStatus('Choosing a folder works inside Premiere Pro.', 'err'); return; }
      var r = window.cep.fs.showOpenDialogEx(false, true, 'Choose the library folder', s.root || '', []);
      var dir = r && r.data && r.data[0];
      if (!dir) return;
      s.root = dir; save(); renderSettings();
      setStatus('Library folder set. Saving your clients there…');
      runSyncAll();
    }
    else if (act === 'open') openPath(s.root);
    else if (act === 'openRendered') { if (nodeFs) openPath(nodePath.join(LIB_DIR, 'Rendered')); }
    else if (act === 'auto') { s.autoSync = el.checked; save(); }
    else if (act === 'syncAll') runSyncAll();
    else if (act === 'importFolder') importClientFolder();
    else if (act === 'duplicate') {
      var copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(c));
      copy.id = uid(); copy.name = c.name + ' copy';
      copy.assets.forEach(function (a) { a.id = uid(); delete a.exportFile; });
      lib.clients.push(copy); lib.activeClient = copy.id; save(); renderClients(); renderSettings();
      if (libraryOn() && s.autoSync) syncClient(copy);
      setStatus('Duplicated as ' + copy.name + '.', 'ok');
    }
    else if (act === 'export') {
      if (!nodeFs || !window.cep) { setStatus('Export works inside Premiere Pro.', 'err'); return; }
      var sv = window.cep.fs.showSaveDialogEx('Export client', LIB_DIR, ['json'], c.name.replace(/[^\w\- ]+/g, '') + '.csk.json');
      if (sv && sv.data) {
        nodeFs.writeFileSync(sv.data, JSON.stringify({ cskClient: 4, client: c }, null, 2), 'utf8');
        setStatus('Exported ' + c.name + '.', 'ok');
      }
    }
    else if (act === 'import') {
      if (!nodeFs || !window.cep) { setStatus('Import works inside Premiere Pro.', 'err'); return; }
      var o = window.cep.fs.showOpenDialogEx(false, false, 'Import client', LIB_DIR, ['json']);
      if (o && o.data && o.data[0]) {
        try {
          var data = JSON.parse(nodeFs.readFileSync(o.data[0], 'utf8'));
          var imp = data.client;
          if (!imp || !Array.isArray(imp.assets)) throw new Error('not a Client Sound Kit file');
          imp.id = uid(); imp.assets.forEach(function (a) { a.id = uid(); delete a.exportFile; });
          lib.clients.push(imp); migrate(lib); lib.activeClient = imp.id; save(); renderClients(); renderSettings();
          setStatus('Imported ' + imp.name + '. Relink any sounds marked missing.', 'ok');
        } catch (err) { setStatus('Couldn’t import: ' + err.message, 'err'); }
      }
    }
  });

  function runSyncAll() {
    if (!libraryOn()) return Promise.resolve();
    syncing = true; if (view === 'settings') renderSettings();
    var n = lib.clients.reduce(function (t, c) { return t + c.assets.length; }, 0);
    setStatus('Saving ' + n + ' sounds to the library folder…');
    var chain = Promise.resolve();
    lib.clients.forEach(function (c) { chain = chain.then(function () { return syncClient(c); }); });
    return chain.then(function () {
      syncing = false; if (view === 'settings') renderSettings();
      setStatus('Saved ' + n + ' sounds for ' + lib.clients.length + ' client' + (lib.clients.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' to the library folder.', 'ok');
    });
  }

  // ---------- Events: header ----------
  $('#clientSelect').addEventListener('change', function (e) {
    editing = null; stopPreview(); bgmSel = {}; lib.activeClient = e.target.value; save(); renderAll();
    setStatus('Switched to ' + client().name + '.');
  });

  $('#addClient').addEventListener('click', function () {
    var name = window.prompt('New client name');
    if (!name || !name.trim()) return;
    var c = { id: uid(), name: name.trim(), assets: [] };
    lib.clients.push(c); lib.activeClient = c.id; editing = null; save(); renderAll();
    setStatus('Created ' + c.name + '.', 'ok');
  });

  $('#renameClient').addEventListener('click', function () {
    var c = client(); var name = window.prompt('Rename client', c.name);
    if (!name || !name.trim()) return;
    var oldDir = libraryOn() ? clientDir(c) : null;
    c.name = name.trim();
    if (oldDir && nodeFs.existsSync(oldDir) && !nodeFs.existsSync(clientDir(c))) {
      try {
        nodeFs.renameSync(oldDir, clientDir(c));
        c.assets.forEach(function (a) {
          if (a.exportFile && inside(oldDir, a.exportFile)) a.exportFile = nodePath.join(clientDir(c), nodePath.relative(oldDir, a.exportFile));
          if (a.path && inside(oldDir, a.path)) a.path = nodePath.join(clientDir(c), nodePath.relative(oldDir, a.path));
        });
        writeClientJson(c);
      } catch (err) { setStatus('Renamed, but couldn’t rename the client folder: ' + err.message, 'err'); }
    }
    save(); renderClients(); if (view === 'settings') renderSettings();
    setStatus('Renamed to ' + c.name + '.', 'ok');
  });

  $('#deleteClient').addEventListener('click', function () {
    var c = client();
    if (lib.clients.length === 1) { setStatus('Keep at least one client. Rename this one instead.', 'err'); return; }
    if (!window.confirm('Delete ' + c.name + ' and its ' + c.assets.length + ' saved sounds? Audio files stay on disk.')) return;
    lib.clients = lib.clients.filter(function (x) { return x.id !== c.id; });
    lib.activeClient = lib.clients[0].id; editing = null; save(); renderAll(); setStatus('Deleted ' + c.name + '.');
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function (t) {
    t.addEventListener('click', function () {
      editing = null; stopPreview(); lib.activeKind = t.dataset.kind; view = 'sounds'; save();
      renderAll();
      if (lib.activeKind === 'check' && inCEP) {
        host('FrameshiftSK.sequenceInfo()').then(function (r) {
          var n = Number(r.split('|')[1]);
          if (n > 0 && n !== seqTracks) { seqTracks = n; renderCheck(); }
        });
      }
    });
  });

  $('#settingsBtn').addEventListener('click', function () { openSettings(view !== 'settings'); });

  // ---------- Add sounds / capture ----------
  $('#addSounds').addEventListener('click', function () { pickFiles(lib.activeKind !== 'part').then(addFiles); });
  $('#captureBtn').addEventListener('click', captureFromTimeline);
  $('#addSelected').addEventListener('click', function () { addFromPremiereSelection(false); });

  // Files dragged in from Explorer/Finder. Drags that start in this panel are ignored here.
  function acceptsDrop() { return view === 'sounds' && lib.activeKind !== 'check' && !internalDrag; }
  var dz = document.body;
  dz.addEventListener('dragover', function (e) { if (!acceptsDrop()) return; e.preventDefault(); $('#dropzone').classList.add('over'); });
  dz.addEventListener('dragleave', function (e) { if (!e.relatedTarget) $('#dropzone').classList.remove('over'); });
  dz.addEventListener('drop', function (e) {
    $('#dropzone').classList.remove('over');
    if (!acceptsDrop()) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var paths = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < e.dataTransfer.files.length; i++) {
      var f = e.dataTransfer.files[i]; if (f.path) paths.push(f.path);
    }
    // Frameshift: Premiere's panel browser may not give File.path; the uri list has every file.
    if (!paths.length) {
      var uris = (e.dataTransfer.getData('text/uri-list') || e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') || '').split(/\r?\n/);
      uris.forEach(function (u) {
        u = u.trim();
        if (!u || u.charAt(0) === '#' || !/^file:/i.test(u)) return;
        var pth = decodeURIComponent(u.replace(/^file:\/\/(localhost)?/i, ''));
        if (/^\/[A-Za-z]:\//.test(pth)) pth = pth.slice(1);
        paths.push(pth);
      });
    }
    if (paths.length) { addFiles(paths); return; }
    // Frameshift: Premiere's panel browser gave no file locations, but it does give the files'
    // contents. Save a copy in the library (Sound Kit/Dropped/<client>) and add that.
    if (!(e.dataTransfer.files || []).length) { setStatus('Reading what you dragged from Premiere\u2026'); addFromPremiereSelection(false); return; }
    var files = [].slice.call(e.dataTransfer.files || []).filter(function (f) { return AUDIO_EXT.test(f.name); });
    if (!files.length) { setStatus('No audio files in that drop. Supported: wav, mp3, aif, m4a, aac, flac, ogg.', 'err'); return; }
    setStatus('Copying ' + files.length + ' dropped file' + (files.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' into the library\u2026');
    var dir = nodePath.join(LIB_DIR, 'Dropped', safeName(client().name));
    mkdirp(dir);
    Promise.all(files.map(function (f) {
      return new Promise(function (resolve) {
        var rd = new FileReader();
        rd.onload = function () {
          try {
            var B = window.require('buffer').Buffer, data = B.from(rd.result), out = nodePath.join(dir, f.name), n = 2;
            // same name already there with different content: keep both
            while (nodeFs.existsSync(out) && nodeFs.statSync(out).size !== data.length) out = nodePath.join(dir, f.name.replace(/(\.[^.]+)$/, ' ' + (n++) + '$1'));
            if (!nodeFs.existsSync(out)) nodeFs.writeFileSync(out, data);
            resolve(out);
          } catch (err) { resolve(null); }
        };
        rd.onerror = function () { resolve(null); };
        rd.readAsArrayBuffer(f);
      });
    })).then(function (copied) {
      copied = copied.filter(Boolean);
      if (copied.length) addFiles(copied);
      else setStatus('Couldn\u2019t read the dropped files. Use Add sounds instead.', 'err');
    });
  });

  window.__cskTest = { joinCaptured: joinCaptured, groupCaptured: groupCaptured, groupKeys: groupKeys, cleanKeys: cleanKeys, withFades: withFades, bgmFadeKeys: bgmFadeKeys, duplicateOf: duplicateOf, encodeWav: encodeWav, renderRange: renderRange, decode: decode, dragSpec: dragSpec, prepareDrag: prepareDrag,
    bandProfile: bandProfile, measure: measure, importFromDir: importFromDir, runSyncAll: runSyncAll,
    lib: function () { return lib; }, check: function () { return check; }, bgmSel: function () { return bgmSel; } };

  // ---------- Boot ----------
  renderAll();
  if (inCEP) {
    host('FrameshiftSK.ping()').then(function (r) {
      if (r.indexOf('OK|') === 0) setStatus('Ready. Move the playhead, then click a sound or drag it to the timeline.');
      else setStatus('Couldn’t talk to Premiere: ' + r, 'err');
    });
    host('FrameshiftSK.sequenceInfo()').then(function (r) { var n = Number(r.split('|')[1]); if (n > 0) seqTracks = n; });
  } else {
    setStatus('Preview mode: open inside Premiere Pro to place sounds.');
  }
})();
